description.en: DSH Web 输入历史插件：Ctrl+Up / Ctrl+Down 像终端一样召回与切换已发送消息，零核心改动
description.zh: 像终端一样用 Ctrl+上/下键快速翻看历史消息，还能保留未发送的草稿，聊天效率翻倍。

description.en: Search and insert workspace file and directory paths with `@`, plus a `/h` menu for reusing prompts from the current session.
description.zh: 在组合框中使用 `@` 搜索并插入工作区文件和目录路径，并通过 `/h` 菜单复用当前会话的问题。

description.en: 一款基于主播女孩重度依赖创建的 适用于 DSH 的 实验性主题皮肤 / Unofficial pixel desktop skin for DSH Web inspired by NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE. Experimental, non-commercial fan project.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 变成主播女孩重度依赖风格的像素桌面，边玩边干活，娱乐工作两不误。

description.en: Drive the user's real browser through the local Kimi WebBridge daemon: navigate, find-tab, snapshot, click, fill, evaluate, CDP, screenshot, network, upload, PDF export and tab-management tools that reuse existing login sessions.
description.zh: 通过本地 Kimi WebBridge 守护进程驱动用户的真实浏览器：navigate、find-tab、snapshot、click、fill、evaluate、CDP、screenshot、network、upload、PDF 导出与标签管理工具，复用浏览器已登录会话。

description.en: KolmoPDF tools for DeepSeek Harness with durable API-key settings and CLI configuration.
description.zh: 专为DeepSeek Harness设计，轻松将PDF转为Markdown或保留排版翻译，配置省心，文档处理更高效。
让多台设备上的 DSH 和 AI 像群聊一样互相交流，自动接话、排队投递，人类随时插话管理。

description.en: 深法：DeepSeek Harness 本地法律工作台插件，提供法律模式原生对话、案件看板、日程期限、可调分栏与多套法律主题
韭菜盒子 LeekBox — A股看盘助手 · DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web 插件
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页左侧边栏一键打开 A 股行情面板，实时盯盘、快速看盘，炒股摸鱼两不误。

description.en: Matter-aware legal workspace dashboard and document agent tools for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Matter-aware legal workspace dashboard and document agent tools for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Multi-agent teams, model routing, and declarative orchestration for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 轻松组建多智能体团队，智能路由模型，并声明式编排复杂任务流程。

description.en: 滑动变祖器
Content-addressed artifact, fact, action and report lineage for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于内容寻址的数据与操作溯源证据，确保插件来源可信、数据可追踪。

description.en: Live2D companion for DSH: a floating Cubism model with state-driven expressions and mouse tracking; config-driven geometry (size/position from the plugin config); official Haru sample bundled (© Live2D Inc.).
description.zh: DSH 的 Live2D 桌宠：悬浮的 Cubism 模型，表情随状态变化并跟随鼠标；尺寸与位置由插件配置驱动；内置官方 Haru 示例模型（© Live2D Inc.）。

description.en: Unified LLM request/response inspector: reasoning-effort tuning, external-think export, traffic & bundle analysis.
description.zh: 统一 LLM 请求/响应检查器：调 reasoning effort、外部思考(think)导出、流量与包分析。

description.en: Ollama Cloud native chat adapter: direct NDJSON translation of the Ollama /api/chat wire format, model discovery with context windows and capabilities, and web search/fetch providers under the ollama-cloud id, plus a Web settings card.
description.zh: Ollama Cloud 原生聊天适配器：直连 NDJSON 翻译 Ollama /api/chat 协议，模型发现带上下文窗口与能力信息，并注册 web 搜索/抓取 provider，附 Web 设置卡片。

description.en: OpenCode Go LLM provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Go 模型，自动按模型选择接口，即插即用。

description.en: dsh插件，将dsh的LLM请求路由到本机Qoder CLI，可使用Qoder credits与模型。
Runs 3 or 5 coding-agent candidates in detached Git worktrees, validates their patches with project commands, ranks only passing candidates, and requires separate approval before applying the winner.
description.zh: 在独立 Git worktree 中运行 3 或 5 个编码智能体候选，用项目命令验证补丁，只对通过者排序，并在应用获胜补丁前要求再次批准。

description.en: A version‑aware adapter registry that decouples third‑party Cordis plugins from dsh’s internal service names, paths, and RPC internals. 基于版本感知适配器注册表，为 dsh Cordis 插件提供运行时兼容层，使第三方插件与内部服务名、模块路径及 RPC 细节解耦。
description.zh: 为 dsh 插件提供版本兼容层，升级后第三方插件无需改动即可继续使用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness の日本語化プラグイン
dsh 登录门卫插件：让只监听本机的 dsh Web UI 安全地对外开放——登录墙 + 全量反代，零依赖、零侵入。
description.zh: 给 dsh 的 Web UI 加一道登录墙，让本机服务安全地对外开放，登录后全功能反代，零依赖零侵入。

description.en: Query local log files with Chinese natural-language time expressions (e.g. "yesterday afternoon", "3 hours ago") — precise time range, matched lines, ERROR/WARN/INFO level stats, fully offline.
description.zh: 用中文自然语言时间描述查询本地日志（如「昨天下午」「3小时前」）——精确时间范围、匹配行、级别统计，完全离线。

description.en: 可以看见ai的执行步骤，将ai的步骤抽出来为对应动画，增加编码时等待的娱乐性。
description.zh: 把AI执行步骤变成可视化动画，在3D办公区里看智能体干活，等代码时不再无聊。

description.en: Loom (织机) — external coach / second verifier for DeepSeek Harness: silently evolves your agent's tools, skills, config and model, with deterministic verification and cold-apply.
Python LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using Pyright.
description.zh: 基于 Pyright 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Python 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: dsh-macos-desktop 把 DSH 的 Web 界面变成一个 macOS 桌面：左侧桌面（多窗口/文件/回收站/便签/Spotlight/天气/深色模式）+ 右侧原生对话（主题化），内置终端、文档(Word/PDF/PPT)、浏览器、知识库、番茄钟、截图、AI 生图与「用 AI 看图」，通过官方 shell.overlay 挂载、卸载即恢复
DeepSeek Plugin that supports MCP Apps
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 变身 MCP 应用宿主，轻松接入并调用 MCP 服务器上的工具。

description.en: Zero-dependency MCP client bridge that connects stdio and HTTP MCP servers and registers their tools as mcp_<server>_<tool> for the agent.
description.zh: 零依赖 MCP 客户端桥接，连接 stdio 与 HTTP MCP server，把其工具注册为 mcp_<server>_<tool> 供 agent 调用。

description.en: Markdown sidebar preview and source editor for dsh-better-sidebar, with block- and text-range annotations that can be sent to the conversation as structured revision requests.
description.zh: 面向 dsh-better-sidebar 扩展的 Markdown 侧边栏预览与源码编辑器，支持块级和文本选区批注，并可将批注作为结构化修改请求发送到对话框。

description.en: Audio/video FileViewer for dsh-better-sidebar: native inline playback for mp4/webm/mkv/mov and mp3/flac/wav, served by a Range-capable streaming media route.
description.zh: better-sidebar 音视频预览器：原生播放器内联播放 mp4/webm/mkv/mov 等视频与 mp3/flac/wav 等音频，自带支持 HTTP Range 拖动的流式媒体路由。

description.en: deepseek harness plugin for medical image analysis
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek 直接看懂医学影像，自动分析病灶并生成报告，辅助医生快速诊断。

description.en: 为dsh构建持久化跨工作区记忆的插件

Vector + graph memory backend: observe/remember/search/recall tools against a local memoria server, fusing HNSW semantic recall, FTS5 keyword search, and knowledge-graph signals via RRF ranking, with automatic turn-end persistence and per-agent namespace isolation.
description.zh: 向量+图记忆后端：observe/remember/search/recall 四个工具对接本地 memoria 服务，HNSW 语义召回 + FTS5 关键词 + 知识图谱信号经 RRF 融合排序，回合结束自动写入，按 Agent 命名空间隔离。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 全局自动记忆插件：会话开始注入记忆、memory_search 检索工具、压缩检查点归档提醒（零写入提醒制）。Global auto-memory plugin for DSH.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化对话记忆：记忆标签页、AI 自动命名、按 AI 隔离的隐私边界、侧栏显示 AI 名称与经验自动归档。以静态 profile 插件形式在所有预设中常驻，重启不丢。

description.en: Two-phase long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): per-session extraction + global consolidation, always-injected summary, and memory_list/read/search/add tools.

Unified messaging gateway for DeepSeek Harness: 27 IM platforms (Telegram, QQ, WeChat, Discord, WhatsApp, Feishu and more) in one plugin, with QR scan-to-authorize, per-platform workspaces, slash commands, and a web setup dialog.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一消息网关：一个插件接入 27 个 IM 平台（Telegram、QQ、微信、Discord、WhatsApp、飞书等），支持扫码授权、每平台独立工作区、斜杠命令与 Web 配置弹窗。

description.en: A model-native meta-agent plugin for DeepSeek Harness that uses the underlying model’s reasoning and planning capabilities to synthesize task-specific workflows at runtime and coordinate tools and subagents.
description.zh: 让模型自己当总指挥，按任务现场编排工作流，自动调度工具和子代理干活。

description.en: Microphone voice input for the composer: browser Web Speech API live transcription, dedupe/auto-continue, smart punctuation, language and auto-send settings.
description.zh: 输入框麦克风语音输入：浏览器 Web Speech API 实时转写，自动去重/续听、智能标点，支持语言与自动发送设置。

description.en: DSH 实时思维导图插件：Agent 与你共编同一棵树，改动即时互相同步，支持停靠分屏与全屏专注两种视图
基于 MinerU 的 DeepSeek Harness 多模态文档解析插件：PDF/Word/PPT/Excel/HTML/图片 → 结构化 Markdown（免 Token 的 Agent 轻量解析 / 精准解析双 API 模式）
description.zh: 基于 MinerU 的多模态文档解析插件，可将 PDF、Word、PPT、图片等转为结构化 Markdown，支持轻量和精准双模式，省 Token 又高效。

description.en: DSH plugin for controlling mobile devices (ADB/iOS) — DeepSeek Harness 操控手机插件
description.zh: dsh-mobile-control — DSH 插件（工具）

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供多供应商真实账户余额显示
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里直接查看多家供应商的真实账户余额，不用来回切换后台。

description.en: Dialog-style model picker for the DSH Web UI: fuzzy search, collapsible provider groups, favorites with a favorites-only filter, and a thinking-level dropdown, replacing the built-in model selector with official UI primitives and DSW tokens.
description.zh: Web UI 模型选择器替换插件：对话框式选择，支持模糊搜索、供应商折叠分组、收藏与只看收藏过滤，以及思考档位下拉，复用官方组件库与 DSW 设计 token。

description.en: Adds searchable filtering to the model selector by provider, model name, and model ID; spaces act as wildcards.
description.zh: 为模型选择器增加按提供方、模型名称和模型 ID 搜索的筛选框，空格表示任意字符。
实时监控 DSH 会话的 token 消耗和费用，按官方峰谷定价计算，在页面右上角显示悬浮窗。

description.en: 简洁、克制、安静，旨在为您的Vibe Coding增加些许文艺感。每次打开WebUI，左下角都会出现一句话，从古诗词到文采句，再到脍炙人口的游戏台词，应有尽有。语料库可高度自定义，插件风格完全适配原生Harness界面，功能简洁明确，绝不喧宾夺主。
description.zh: 每次打开WebUI，左下角自动显示一句古诗词或经典台词，给Vibe Coding加点文艺感，语料库还能自己定制。

description.en: Multi-model orchestrator: the main brain decomposes complex tasks and dispatches subtasks to GLM / Kimi / Qwen sub-agents by each model's strengths, with per-model token usage.
description.zh: 多模型主脑编排器：主模型将复杂任务拆解，按各模型优劣分派给 GLM / Kimi / Qwen 子代理执行，并按模型统计 token 用量。

description.en: Codex-style multiple independent selection comments for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
description.zh: 在AI回复中连续选中多段文字，分别写下要求，一次性提交，让对话更精准高效。

description.en: dsh-multimodal — DSH plugin (llm)
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek 安装一双眼睛和一支画笔:会话里直接贴截图/图片,GLM 视觉模型先精确转写图片内容(报错信息、代码、界面逐字保留),然后 DeepSeek 继续处理你的问题——同一轮完成,全程无感;需要配图时,DeepSeek 自动调用文生图后端出图并显示在会话中。

description.en: 添加deepseek harness生图识图能力插件
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加图像识别与生成能力，让模型能看懂图片并产出新图像。

description.en: Shows coding-plan usage and balance for 5 AI providers (MiniMax, DeepSeek, Kimi, OpenRouter, Zhipu) beside the composer input, switching with the selected model and reusing API keys configured in DSH model settings.
description.zh: 在 composer 输入框旁显示 5 家 AI 套餐用量与余额（MiniMax、DeepSeek、Kimi、OpenRouter、智谱），跟随当前模型自动切换，复用 DSH 模型设置里已配的 API Key。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness music plugin (dsh-plugin)
description.zh: dsh-music-plugin — DSH 插件（工具）

description.en: A collapsible/expandable draggable floating music player with NetEase Cloud Music playlist import and song/artist search — chat and listen at the same time.
description.zh: 可折叠/展开、自由拖动的悬浮音乐播放器，接入网易云音乐，支持歌单导入和按歌名或歌手搜索单曲导入，边对话边听歌。

description.en: nebula v5 plugin for deepseek harness
description.zh: 连接 NebulaGraph v5 图数据库，在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接执行 ISO-GQL 查询语句。

description.en: Evidence-bound negative-knowledge ledger: persists disproven paths (command_failed, file_missing) with their outcome and precondition evidence, then warns or blocks repeat attempts until the evidence changes.
description.zh: 证据约束的负面知识账本：记录被证伪的路径（command_failed / file_missing）及其结果与前置条件证据，重复尝试时警告或拦截，证据变化后自动解除。

description.en: Lets sandboxed agents reach the web through your local proxy: net_fetch fetches pages, net_proxy_status reports proxy status.
description.zh: 让沙箱里的 agent 通过你的本地代理联网：net_fetch 抓取网页，net_proxy_status 查看代理状态。

description.en: Visual node-based workflow canvas for DSH with sub-agent calls, code execution, branching, loops, scheduling, and workflow import/export.
description.zh: DSH 可视化节点工作流画布，支持子 Agent 调用、代码执行、条件分支、循环、定时任务及工作流导入导出。

description.en: 对话节点导航：DSH Web GUI 右侧节点串，hover 预览、点击跳转、active 药丸跟随阅读位置

A plugin enabling DSH to directly control Universal Robots (UR) arms using natural language, developed by Nonead Technology based on the self-developed nUR MCP Server's source logic. (Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.)
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接用自然语言控制优傲机器人机械臂，实现自动化操作。

description.en: havingautism/dsh-notebooks 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。
description.zh: havingautism/dsh-notebooks 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web notifications plugin
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供浏览器通知功能，让任务完成或需要关注时及时提醒你。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) web plugin: plays a sound when the agent finishes replying (turn/end). Sound, volume and on/off configurable in Settings.
description.zh: AI 回复完自动播提示音，支持换音效、调音量，干活时不用一直盯着屏幕。

description.en: "Single-Core Writing" plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Thoroughly tool-streamlined and output-hardened for quantized small models, suitable for running long-novel pipelines locally with on-device models.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的「单核写作」插件：面向量化小模型做了充分的工具瘦身与输出加固，适合在本机用本地模型跑长篇小说流水线。

description.en: dsh's tui base on nvim
description.zh: 把 Neovim 变成 dsh 的终端界面，用熟悉的编辑操作和分屏来查看、操控智能体任务。

description.en: Zero-touch runtime telemetry for DSH: every session auto-writes task, model tier, tools, failures, duration, status into a human-readable journal with a stats section (pure observer — no tools, no LLM calls, no injection).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 零侵入运行事实遥测：每个会话自动把任务/模型档位/工具/失败/时长/状态写入人机共读观测卡并附统计区（纯观察者——零工具、零 LLM、零注入）。

description.en: Obsidian bridge plugin for DSH
description.zh: 把 Obsidian 变成 DSH 的本地控制台，直接在笔记里管理和运行 DeepSeek Harness 任务。

description.en: Off-peak message scheduler: turn on valley mode and the composer queues your messages until DeepSeek off-peak hours (half price), then auto-injects them into the session and gets replies. Native-look composer, hotkeys (Enter queue / ⌘+Enter send now / Esc exit), per-session toggle persisted across restarts.
description.zh: 谷时发送调度器：开启谷时模式后输入框消息排队至 DeepSeek 谷时窗口（半价）自动注入会话并得到回复。原生外观输入条、快捷键（Enter 入队 / ⌘+Enter 立即发送 / Esc 退出）、按会话记忆的开关，重启不丢。

description.en: dsh plugin for DeepSeek Harness: complete Office document tools for the agent (create/read/edit .docx/.xlsx/.pptx via OfficeCLI) plus high-fidelity document preview in the dsh web sidebar through dsh-better-sidebar.
Omni Router - auto-routing DeepSeek Harness preset: simple tasks run directly, complex tasks plan first with approval gate.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一层任务级可靠性，自动判断何时介入、验证证据并处理失败，让结果更靠谱。

description.en: OneBot Adapter For DSH
description.zh: OneBot v11 适配器：HTTP、正向/反向 WebSocket 都支持。

description.en: Safe OpenAPI 3.x discovery and API calling tools for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Safe OpenAPI 3.x discovery and API calling tools for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: DSH web UI 悬浮面板：OpenCode Go 月度/滚动/每周额度余额 + 用量监控（key 本地读取，各自显示自己的余额）

OpenCode Go plan usage display for the DSH web GUI: a persistent badge under the composer shows rolling/weekly/monthly usage percents with reset countdowns; click to expand a card; agents can query the balance via the `opencode_go_usage` tool.
description.zh: OpenCode Go 套餐用量显示：输入框下方常驻徽章显示滚动 / 每周 / 每月用量百分比与重置倒计时，点击展开进度卡片；Agent 可经 `opencode_go_usage` 工具随时查询余额。

description.en: Agent config packer for DeepSeek Harness: pack local agent assets (skills/sessions/profiles/settings/memory) into a zip for migration or sharing, with privacy scanning, diff-based restore, pack management, and a settings panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Agent 配置打包器：把本地 Agent 资产（Skills/会话/Profile/全局设置/记忆）打包成 zip，用于迁移或分享；带隐私安全扫描、恢复差异对比、包管理与设置面板。

description.en: PaddleOCR skills for DeepSeek Harness with native tools and GUI configuration
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 PaddleOCR 文字识别能力，自带原生工具和图形界面配置，开箱即用。

description.en: An accumulated design-taste corpus for DSH agents: feed good and bad examples, distill principles, and review new designs against learned judgment rather than a fixed ruleset.
description.zh: 给 DSH agent 的积累型设计品味语料库：喂好坏例子、提炼原则，用学到的判断评审新设计，而不是套固定规则。

description.en: Per-host personalization for DSH: custom instructions, local long-term memory, and reply-tone presets.
description.zh: 为本机所有对话提供个性化设置：自定义指令、长期记忆和回复语气预设，让AI更懂你。

description.en: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI: sprite-sheet animation, agent state linkage, drag, alarm (daily/one-shot) and pomodoro widgets, skin picker with preview.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌面宠物：精灵图动画、agent 状态联动、拖拽、闹钟（每天/一次）与番茄钟，皮肤下拉选择 + 预览。

description.en: 桌宠小鲸鱼：DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web 桌宠插件，随 agent 状态切换动画，纯 DOM 零依赖
description.zh: 官方鲸鱼轮廓的桌宠：纯 SVG 动画随 agent 状态切换（思考／工作／完成／报错），可戳可拖、双击翻滚，光标停留在身侧会自己避让，7 套色板并跟随亮暗主题，附网页预览可直接试玩。

description.en: Run trusted Pi extensions inside DeepSeek Harness through a compatibility host.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里跑可信的 Pi 扩展：兼容宿主直接运行未经修改的 Pi extensions。

description.en: Adds persistent execution contracts, recursive work graphs, critical clarification, and evidence gates for long or underspecified Harness tasks.
description.zh: 为长期或定义不完整的 Harness 任务提供持久执行合同、递归工作图、关键澄清与证据门禁。

description.en: DSH 会话切换面板插件（Ctrl+K / Ctrl+[ ]，npm 可装）+ 插件开发模板
description.zh: DSH 会话切换面板插件（Ctrl+K / Ctrl+[ ]，npm 可装）+ 插件开发模板

description.en: Search-first capability workflow for DSH agents (v1.0.0): reuse local tools or review exact-source plugins before installation, adapt or create capabilities in managed source work, and use receipts that distinguish installed, loaded, activated, and verified states; version tools cover rollback, adoption, and upstream updates.
description.zh: AutoEvo v1.0.0 为 DSH Agent 提供 Search-first 能力工作流：优先复用本地工具或审查精确来源插件后再安装；可在受管源码中改造或新建能力；回执区分 installed、loaded、activated、verified，版本工具支持回滚、领养与上游更新。
DSH 插件市场入口加运维面板，浏览 252+ 插件，查看安装状态，一键安装、更新、卸载，还提供两个 agent 工具。

description.en: 在 Web GUI 里可视化管理项目的全部能力——Skills、MCP 服务器、快捷消息， 全部支持项目级 / 全局级双作用域，全部可以不离开浏览器完成安装、启停与分发
description.zh: 在浏览器里可视化管理项目的 Skills、MCP 服务器和快捷消息，支持项目级/全局级双作用域，无需离开页面即可完成安装、启停与分发。

description.en: Off-transcript clarification Host plugin for DeepSeek Harness
Docker 容器沙箱部署级插件(与 dsh-plugin-vm-sandbox 全能力对齐,无需 OrbStack):39 个 docker_* 模型工具、快照/回滚、文件传输、端口转发、后台任务、审计、共享/配额/回收、网络策略与华丽原生 UI。
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Docker 容器沙箱，支持快照回滚、文件传输、端口转发等完整运维能力，并带原生可视化界面。

description.en: DeepEye vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): image description, OCR, VQA, UI layout, and clipboard analysis.
description.zh: dsh-plugin-deepeye — DSH 插件（模型）

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 底部状态栏实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 底部状态栏实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: Plugin family for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI: a pnpm monorepo with a plugin template, dev kit, and one-command all-in-one bundle — Codegraph, env & secrets, MCP config, profiles, prompts, RSS digest, global search, and terminal panel.
description.zh: DSH 插件全家桶，集环境变量、密钥管理、MCP 配置、提示词与配置档案于一体，一站式提升开发效率。

description.en: DSH 插件管理器：内置/三方插件安装、卸载、启动、停用与 GitHub 直跳
description.zh: 在 Web 设置页一站式管理 DSH 插件，支持安装、卸载、启用、停用，还能从 GitHub 搜索安装或一键装载非 bundle 插件。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的**第三方插件管理器**：在 Web UI 设置页选择第三方插件库文件夹，搜索其中所有第三方插件，并一键关闭/启动（刷新 dsh 后生效）。
description.zh: 在 dsh 设置页选择第三方插件库，一键启用或停用插件，刷新后生效，轻松管理扩展功能。

description.en: DSH 插件管理, 一键启用/禁用插件
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里直接启用、禁用或删除插件，改完立即生效，不用手动改配置文件。

description.en: Structured long-term memory system for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: dsh-plugin-meta-memory — DSH 插件（会话）

description.en: Midscene-based AI UI automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness (android_ui + web_ui)
description.zh: 基于 Midscene 的 AI UI 自动化——android_ui 与 web_ui 工具，通过 ctx.midscene seam 在真实 Android 设备或已运行的 Chrome 上完成点击、输入、查询与断言。

description.en: DSH tools for reproducing and validating the ml-quant-trading protocol v1 CPU benchmark, then drafting an issue-ready report. Requires a local clone of initial-d/ml-quant-trading (set as the workspace or repoPath) plus Python and PyTorch; this plugin does not fetch the repository or install its dependencies.
description.zh: 用于复现并校验 ml-quant-trading protocol v1 CPU 基准测试，并生成可提交 issue 报告的 DSH 工具。需要本地 clone initial-d/ml-quant-trading，并将其设为 workspace 或 repoPath，同时自行准备 Python 和 PyTorch；本插件不会获取仓库或安装依赖。

description.en: MuApi media-generation tool: a muapi_generate tool that submits and polls jobs against any of MuApi's 100+ image, video, audio, and 3D models through one x-api-key.
description.zh: MuApi 媒体生成工具：muapi_generate 工具通过一个 x-api-key 提交并轮询 MuApi 100 多个图片、视频、音频与 3D 模型的生成任务。

description.en: Advertise image paste on text-only DeepSeek routes, describe attachments with a vision sidecar, and leave native vision models untouched.
description.zh: 在纯文本 DeepSeek 线路上开放贴图准入，用视觉 sidecar 把附件转成文字，原生视觉模型不改写。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 网页端的 AI 与科技快讯看板：内置 RSS/JSON 源驱动的可拖拽浮窗，支持双语翻译、关键词过滤和设置页。
ChatGPT Codex and xAI Grok subscription OAuth for DeepSeek Harness — PKCE / device-code, local Responses proxy, llm-pi-ai sync
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 和本地代理，将 ChatGPT Codex、xAI Grok、智谱 GLM、AWS Kiro、Google Antigravity 与 Cursor 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Bridge opencode skills and config into DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: dsh-plugin-opencode-bridge — DSH 插件（技能）

description.en: deepseek harness opencode + omo (oh-my-openagent) preset
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 集成 opencode 与 oh-my-openagent 预设，开箱即用，提升开发效率。

description.en: ChatGPT-style right-edge turn navigation plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web
Zero-config web_search for DeepSeek Harness when you are not on the official DeepSeek API.
description.zh: 不用官方 DeepSeek API 也能用内置 web_search：关掉 web-search-deepseek，默认走 Tavily keyless。

description.en: Adds a native Store section to DSH Settings for catalog search, tag filtering, sorting, installation, and installed-plugin management.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中加入原生插件商店，支持目录搜索、标签筛选、排序、安装与已安装插件管理。

description.en: 酒馆（SillyTavern 精简版）DSH 插件：角色卡解析管理员 card-analyst + 角色扮演讲述者 roleplay
【已停止维护】DeepSeek Harness 视觉桥接插件：新版 Harness 已原生支持图片识别，请使用原生能力，本仓库仅作历史参考。
description.zh: 上传或粘贴图片，自动生成英文描述，让纯文本模型也能看懂图片内容。

description.en: DSH 用户插件管理器:在 设置→插件 统一管理插件目录散件、运行树插件与 npm 插件包——挂载/卸载/启用/停用(cordis.patch.yml 补丁层 + HMR 热生效)
description.zh: 在设置→插件里统一管理所有插件，支持挂载、卸载、启用和停用，还能热生效，不用重启。

description.en: The model switch for DSH: point it at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with curated free/cheap DeepSeek provider presets and automatic fallback when a free tier rate-limits you.
description.zh: DSH 的模型切换器：指向任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，内置精选免费/低价 DeepSeek 服务商预设，免费额度限流时自动回退。

description.en: Polymarket toolkit for DeepSeek Harness and Claude Code: market-data tools for Gamma/CLOB/Data-API (31 model tools in DSH; read-only subset exposed over MCP), opt-in authenticated trading tools, WebSocket stream service, and an embedded Polymarket knowhow skill.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 与 Claude Code 的 Polymarket 工具包：Gamma/CLOB/Data-API 行情工具（DSH 内 31 个模型工具，MCP 只暴露只读子集）、需显式开启的带鉴权交易工具、WebSocket 推流服务，以及内置的 Polymarket 知识技能。

description.en: Self-contained power control for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar power button with upward restart/shutdown menu, Windows-shutdown-style overlay, own restart & shutdown engine (no dependency on other plugins).
Native DeepSeek Harness plugin: gates pwsh tool calls against PowerShell pitfalls via the official tools/pre-execute interception point, bundles the powershell-check skill

DSH 演示文稿技能 + 工具插件：一句话 / 一篇 Markdown → HTML 网页放映 + 可编辑 PPTX；5 套视觉主题、页间转场 + 要点入场动画（motion 可关）、金句/表格/演讲者备注，薄 SKILL.md + references 按需装载，零运行时依赖跨 harness。· Presentation skill & tools for DeepSeek Harness agents. 已验证兼容 DeepSeek Harness v0.1.2-alpha.5。
description.zh: 演示文稿技能与工具：一句话或一篇文档生成 HTML 放映与可编辑 PPTX，7 种页型（含金句与原生 PPTX 表格），演讲者备注（HTML 按 S 呼出 + PPTX 原生备注页），内置 5 套主题，可配置默认主题/语言，中英双语。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 持久化、审批驱动的项目编排工作台
description.zh: 内置状态持久化与审批关卡，帮你把零散任务串成完整项目流，让复杂编排更省心。

description.en: Auditable workspace-local project Wiki with a native Web UI for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把开发过程中的架构知识和决策沉淀成工作区 Wiki，支持阅读、编辑、审查和提交 Git，让团队随时查阅。

description.en: 增强提示词魔法棒:DSH Web 对话输入框的灵活自适应提示词增强插件
description.zh: 在DSH对话输入框加个魔法棒按钮，一键把口语化、零散的输入润色成精准清晰的提示词，让AI更懂你。

description.en: Prompt enhancement plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: one-click rewrite of the composer draft into a structured prompt, with preview, fill-back, and undo.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里一键把草稿改写成结构化提示词，支持预览、回填和撤销，写提示词更省心。

description.en: 增强提示词魔法棒:DSH Web 对话输入框的灵活自适应提示词增强插件
Adds a prompt-enhancement button to the DSH composer that rewrites drafts into agent-ready prompts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框添加提示词增强按钮，将草稿改写为可直接交给 Agent 执行的提示词。

description.en: Prompt enhancement for the composer: an "✨ Enhance" button rewrites your draft prompt into a clearer, more structured version with first-principles thinking, grounded in session context, memory and recent conversation; asks clarifying questions in a card when key info is missing, then previews the result before applying it to the input.
description.zh: 输入框提示词增强：✨ 增强按钮用第一性原理、结合会话上下文/记忆/最近对话，把草稿扩写为更清晰、更结构化的提示词；关键信息缺失时以提问卡片澄清，预览确认后再应用到输入框。

description.en: Bash-like prompt history for the DSH web composer: Up/Down arrows recall previously submitted messages, sourced from the session's own message log (zero config, zero extra storage).
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供类 Linux shell 的终端式输入：↑/↓ 提示词历史（前缀搜索 + Ctrl+R）、选中工具栏（复制/引用）、右键直接粘贴、可开关的会话目录。

description.en: 将原作者 linshenkx 的 prompt-optimizer 移植到 DeepSeek Harness 的第三方插件（非官方）
description.zh: 把 prompt-optimizer 移植到 DeepSeek Harness，自动优化你的提示词，让 AI 回答更聪明。

description.en: Cross-session usage & cost observatory for the DeepSeek Harness web profile — trend/heatmap dashboards, per-model peak-hour pricing (CNY/USD), official DeepSeek balance with spend reconciliation.
description.zh: 跨会话统计 DeepSeek Harness 的用量与费用，提供趋势热力图、分时段价格和余额对账，帮你掌握成本。

description.en: QQ 2007-inspired DSH Web skin: 72 native theme tokens, scoped three-pane chrome, original offline art and pixel buddy, an optional synthesized send chime, responsive/accessibility fallbacks, and reversible Settings switches.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 QQ 2007 风格皮肤：72 个原生主题 token、作用域三栏窗框、原创离线素材与像素伙伴、可选合成发送提示音、响应式/无障碍回退和可恢复设置开关。

description.en: 让 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）住进 QQ：基于腾讯官方 Bot API，支持私聊白名单、持久会话、模型切换与远程权限审批。
description.zh: Security-first QQ Bot channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness, built on Tencent's official SDK

description.en: Replay a DeepSeek Harness session at its original token cadence — an in-app playback theater with play/pause/step/speed/seek.
DeepSeek Harness plugin that auto-nudges agents to consult docs or web search when local trial-and-error becomes costly. DeepSeek Harness 插件：当本地试错成本升高时，自动注入检索提示，引导 Agent 查阅文档或联网搜索。

A small self-contained power control for DSH: sidebar power button with an upward restart/shutdown menu and a Windows-shutdown-style overlay. Own restart & shutdown engine (no dependency on other plugins), dynamic-port aware.
description.zh: 一个小而自洽的 DSH 电源控制插件：侧边栏电源按钮 + 上拉「重启/关机」菜单 + Windows 关机风格过渡遮罩。自带重启/关机引擎（不依赖其它插件），动态端口适配。

description.en: DSH Web right-side output dock that collects session artifacts, previews user-facing files, and preserves tab state per session.
description.zh: DSH Web 原生右侧产物栏，按会话收集用户产物，预览用户可读文件并保存标签状态。

description.en: CodeBuddy supplier plugin for dsh-router. Handles one account at a time with polling OAuth login and token refresh, leaving account selection, cooldown and check-in to dsh-router core.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 CodeBuddy 供应商插件。单账号负责轮询式 OAuth 登录与令牌刷新，选号、冷却与签到交由 dsh-router 核心处理。

description.en: Agent run-rhythm guard for DeepSeek Harness: reasoning dead-loop interception (guard) + automatic continuation after premature stops (continue)
description.zh: 守护 Agent 运行节奏，防止推理死循环或过早收工，让长任务稳定跑完。

description.en: DSH STORE — third-party plugin marketplace and guarded lifecycle manager for DeepSeek Harness.
DSH compatibility plugin for redundant same-mode sandbox escalation requests
description.zh: dsh-same-mode-sandbox-noop — DSH 插件（沙箱）

description.en: DSH sandbox tester: process-isolated testing ground for DeepSeek Harness
省钱+余额监控悬浮窗（DSH Web UI 插件）：DeepSeek / OpenCode Go 双标签余额、限额监控（金额/tok/小时）、语音提醒、超限断点截断
DeepSeek Harness（DSH）定时任务 + 状态监控插件：按 cron 时间表自动触发 Agent 执行任务，/status 与设置页仪表盘查看系统与 harness 综合状态。Scheduled tasks (cron) + status monitoring plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 按 cron 定时自动跑 Agent 任务，还能随时查看系统和 Harness 的运行状态，省心又高效。

description.en: Context visibility + GitHub-style usage heatmap for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — Codex-style /context lens + 53-week contribution graph
description.zh: 实时查看上下文占用，并用 GitHub 风格热力图回顾 53 周 token 使用趋势，帮你掌控每次对话的“内存”消耗。

description.en: DSH web plugin: ChatGPT-style scroll timeline on the chat sidebar — magnetic mountain hover, click to jump to user messages. Derived from vlln/dsh-navbar (MIT).
description.zh: ChatGPT 风格侧栏滚动时间轴：磁性吸附的时间刻度条。

description.en: DSH provider-level web search failover pool: 8 free/paid backends with quota-aware circuit breaking (keeps native web_search)
description.zh: 原生 web_search 的搜索池：8 个免费/付费后端自动故障转移与额度感知熔断，设置页管理 API Key、自定义 SearXNG 实例、failover/rotate 策略切换与 SerpApi 实时额度查询。

description.en: Session row menu extras for DeepSeek Harness: pin sessions, copy session id, export structured Markdown, and permanently delete sessions.
description.zh: 会话行菜单增强：置顶会话、复制会话 ID、导出结构化 Markdown、弹窗确认后永久删除会话。

description.en: Session execution analytics: steps, tool calls, failures, repeated actions, token usage and verification signals, rendered as text/Markdown/JSON reports.
description.zh: 会话执行分析：步骤、工具调用、失败、重复动作、token 用量与验证信号，输出 text/Markdown/JSON 报告。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：回复/提问/审批三类会话通知（系统原生 toast）+ 会话内梯子目录导航。DeepSeek Harness plugin: session notifications (reply/ask/approval) with native OS toasts + an in-conversation ladder outline.
description.zh: AI回复、提问、审批时自动弹系统通知，会话内快速跳转目录，提升多任务处理效率。

description.en: Diagnose, unstick, and read DSH sessions: list sessions with agent status, read conversations, diagnose stuck agents, recover them with cancel+keepInbox, and send messages to other sessions.
description.zh: 会话医生：列出会话（含 agent 运行状态）、读取会话记录、诊断卡死的 agent、解卡（cancel + keepInbox 保留排队消息）、向其他会话发送消息。

description.en: Export sessions to Markdown/JSON for review, replay, and per-session cost summaries.
description.zh: 会话导出为 Markdown/JSON，便于复盘、重放与单会话成本汇总。

description.zh: 长对话太乱？一键把当前会话总结成文档，开个新会话接着聊，上下文不丢。
在 DSH 设置面板里集中管理聊天会话，支持归档、取消归档和彻底删除本地记录，补足官方缺失的会话管理能力。

description.en: A Cordis plugin for DeepSeek Harness that suspends the entire conversation state and resumes it after restart.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Diagnose and safely repair corrupted DSH session history: raw zstd/JSONL validation, tool-call ID repair, single-slot pre-repair backup, restore, and an audit trail.
description.zh: 诊断并安全修复损坏的 DSH 会话历史：raw zstd/JSONL 校验、tool-call ID 修复、单槽 pre-repair 备份与恢复、审计记录。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加一个会话内容检索——标题/内容一键切换，还能按用户/回复/工具筛选
description.zh: 给侧边栏加上会话搜索，能按标题或内容找，还支持按用户、回复、工具筛选，快速定位历史对话。

description.en: DSH web sidebar session-search enhancement: one-click toggle between title search and content search; content results aggregated per session with title and hit snippets.
description.zh: DSH web 侧边栏会话搜索增强：标题搜索与内容搜索一键切换，内容搜索按会话聚合展示标题与命中片段

description.en: Lets you choose which items appear in the DeepSeek Harness settings left nav.
description.zh: 让你选择 DeepSeek Harness 设置页左侧导航要显示哪些栏目。

description.en: Access your DeepSeek Harness (dsh) workspace over a secure public tunnel — from your phone, or from anywhere with a public URL.
dsh-plugin
description.zh: 在主对话外开一条并行 agent 会话，独立上下文共享工作区，结束后把结论摘要带回，不污染主对话。

description.en: Codex-style temporary side conversations for DeepSeek Harness

description.zh: DSH 本機工具調用防護外掛：攔截高風險 Shell 指令模式與敏感憑證讀取，具備持久化哈希鏈 JSONL 審計記錄，可選配外部 Gateway 集中治理。

description.en: Requires one-shot user approval before configured tools (default bash, pwsh) execute — gated tools pause and ask, everything else delegates, and a missing approval channel fails closed.
description.zh: 在配置的工具（默认 bash、pwsh）执行前要求一次性用户审批：受控工具暂停并询问，其余委托执行，缺少审批渠道时默认拒绝。

description.en: Redacts supported secret patterns from the `session-telemetry/record` export copy before configured telemetry backends receive it.
description.zh: 在已配置遥测后端接收前，对 `session-telemetry/record` 导出副本中的已支持秘密模式进行脱敏。

description.en: Autonomous permission classifier for the auto preset: tool-scoped allow/deny rules, an LLM semantic judge, and git checkpointing for unattended sessions.
description.zh: auto（自主模式）权限分类器：工具作用域的放行/拒绝规则、LLM 语义裁判与 git 快照，面向无人值守会话。

description.en: Forge quality gates for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): task gates, read-before-edit, bash hazard interception and quality scoring, driven by the forge CLI through DSH's typed interception points.

Adds a "用量" section to the DSH Settings page that shows your MiniMax Token Plan usage (5h and weekly windows with reset countdowns), per-model breakdown, and video bonus credits; fetches `/v1/token_plan/remains` via a trusted plugin that holds the API key, auto-hides when no key is configured. MIT.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页「用量」section 展示 MiniMax Token Plan 的 5 小时 / 周窗口用量（带重置倒计时）、单模型明细与视频赠送额度；通过 trusted plugin 调 `/v1/token_plan/remains` 拿 key，未配置 key 时整段 section 自动隐藏。MIT。

description.en: WeChat Reading (WeRead) multi-target export for DeepSeek Harness via the official Skills API gateway: browse your bookshelf, export highlights & thoughts to flomo, a local Markdown file, or Notion, optionally reworked by a configurable LLM prompt.
description.zh: 微信读书多目标导出：通过官方 Skills API Key 查看书架、导出划线/想法到 flomo、本地 Markdown 或 Notion，可选按自定义 LLM prompt 整理后再导出。

description.en: Route OpenRouter requests through a configured provider list and quantization cap, injected as provider.only/order with allow_fallbacks, plus provider.quantizations.
description.zh: 配置 OpenRouter 请求使用的提供商列表与量化位数上限，注入 provider.only/order（allow_fallbacks）与 provider.quantizations 路由参数。

description.en: Share the current session over the LAN as a read-only, token-guarded HTML snapshot with session stats and Markdown rendering.
description.zh: 将当前会话以只读、token 保护的 HTML 快照分享到局域网，附带会话统计与 Markdown 渲染。

description.en: Modular frontier execution discipline for DSH: evidence-first routing across 25 skills, Manus-style file planning, verification gates, fail-streak recovery, and an interactive web dashboard.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的模块化前沿执行纪律：覆盖 25 项技能的循证路由、Manus 风格持久化文件规划、验证门禁、失败恢复与交互式 Web 看板。

description.en: Windows-only computer use for DeepSeek Harness: captures the virtual screen and drives mouse & keyboard through 9 tools built on PowerShell and Win32 SendInput; pairs with picturereader so text-only models can complete the screenshot-analyze-act-verify loop fully locally.
description.zh: 仅 Windows 的 DSH 电脑操作插件：以 PowerShell + Win32 SendInput 实现 9 个工具，截取虚拟屏幕并驱动鼠标键盘；配合 picturereader 让纯文本模型在本地完成「截图-分析-操作-验证」闭环。

description.en: Chain-of-thought leakage linter: zero-dependency CLI that finds AI-session residue in docs and comments (dead design citations, PR vantage, change narration, review choreography), shipping the cot-trim fixing skill as the installable bundle.
description.zh: 思维链泄漏检测：零依赖 CLI 扫描 AI 留在文档与注释里的会话残留（死设计引用、PR 视角、变更叙述、评审编排），内置 cot-trim 语义修复技能包。

description.en: Tavily Search API as a web search provider (settings toggle with DeepSeek fallback, keyless search) plus a Tavily MCP bridge: keyless search and extract tools, crawl and map with an API key.
description.zh: Tavily 网页搜索：设置页开关，关闭时回落到 DeepSeek 内置搜索；免密钥可用搜索与内容提取，配置 API Key 后解锁爬取与站点地图等 MCP 工具。

description.en: Official DeepSeek platform monitoring inside the provider card: a live balance chip left of the composer model name plus an expandable account-details panel with per-model monthly usage and a daily stacked chart.
description.zh: 在官方供应商卡片内实时监控 DeepSeek 余额与开放平台用量——输入框工具行模型名称左侧的余额 chip，可展开的账户明细面板含按模型用量与每日堆叠图表。

description.en: Adds a take screenshot tool plus two optional automatic capture points, putting the screen into the conversation as an image block; requires an image-capable model.
description.zh: 一个截图工具，外加两个默认关闭的自动截图时机。需要模型支持图片输入。

description.en: Clinical documentation and reference bundle for healthcare professionals: SOAP/APSO progress notes, admission H&P, SBAR/I-PASS handover, discharge summaries, Safe Harbor de-identification, patient-instruction readability, completeness checks, and cited lookups against FDA labels, MedlinePlus, PubMed, and ClinicalTrials.gov. Draft-only with a PHI egress guard; not a medical device.
description.zh: 面向临床人员的文档与参考工具包：SOAP/APSO 病程录、入院 H&P、SBAR/I-PASS 交接班、 出院小结、Safe Harbor 脱敏、患者须知可读性评分、完整性检查，以及来自 FDA 说明书、 MedlinePlus、PubMed 和 ClinicalTrials.gov 的带出处检索。仅起草不决定， 内置 PHI 外发守卫；非医疗器械。

description.en: OpenCode Go balance pill at the right end of the composer tool row: rolling/weekly/monthly quota remaining straight from the Zen usage endpoint, with hover detail and warn/danger coloring.
description.zh: 输入框工具行右侧的 OpenCode Go 余额胶囊：滚动/每周/每月配额剩余百分比（数据直接来自 Zen 用量接口），悬停查看明细，低余额自动变黄/变红。

description.en: Dual-ledger cross-session memory: auto-extracts lasting facts from conversations into MEMORY.md and maintains a PROGRESS.md project ledger, recalling both into every new session.
description.zh: 双账本跨会话记忆：自动把对话中的长期事实提取进 MEMORY.md，并维护项目进度账本 PROGRESS.md，每个新会话自动召回两本账。

description.en: Vision toolkit for text-only DeepSeek: model-invokable `vision` tool, wrapper adapters for deepseek/opencode-go (v4 flash/pro), Antigravity IDE quota (default, flash/pro) / any OpenAI-compatible VLM / Gemini / local Ollama channels, evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.
description.zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的识图工具包：模型可主动调用的 `vision` 工具、deepseek/opencode-go 包装适配器（v4 flash/pro）、反重力额度（默认，flash/pro）/ 任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM / Gemini / 本地 Ollama 通道、证据记忆与会话压缩恢复、内容哈希缓存、双语客户端面板。

description.en: Interactive canvas for visualizing Agent, Subagent, Workflow, Phase, and tool relationships in DSH Web.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供可交互画布，用于展示 Agent、Subagent、Workflow、Phase 与工具调用之间的关系。

description.en: Warm light and dark theme for DSH Web with responsive layout, bilingual settings, safe Markdown preview, per-block copy controls, and no telemetry.
description.zh: DSH Web 暖中性色明暗主题，支持响应式布局、双语设置、安全 Markdown 预览、内容块复制与无遥测运行。

description.en: Conversation and workspace undo: use the /undo timeline, session-header action, or message icon to roll back before any sent prompt; private Shadow Git snapshots restore files, the reverted turns stay out of model context, and Undo Rollback can recover mistakes. Includes archived-session management and per-tool colored cards.
description.zh: 对话与工作区撤销：通过 /undo 节点轴、会话头部按钮或消息下方图标回滚到任意已发送 prompt 之前；插件私有 Shadow Git 快照恢复文件，被回滚回合不会进入模型上下文，误操作还能“撤回回滚”。附带归档会话管理与工具卡片分类配色。

description.en: Shows the selected model provider's account balance next to the composer's model seat once a model and reasoning effort are selected.
description.zh: 在选择模型与推理强度后，于输入框模型选择器旁显示当前模型提供方的账户余额。

description.en: Scheduled cron tasks, background automation and agent execution for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 定时执行任务，支持后台自动化与智能体调度，让工作流自动跑起来。

description.en: Layered file memory for DeepSeek Harness with workspace-scoped USER/MEMORY notes, background consolidation, and hybrid session recall.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 分层文件记忆，提供工作区隔离的 USER/MEMORY 笔记、后台沉淀与混合会话召回。

description.en: ZCode-style persistent project memory with a full settings manager, index-first injection and agent memory tools.
description.zh: ZCode 风格持久化项目记忆：设置内完整管理页、索引式注入与 agent 记忆工具。

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go quota usage in the web sidebar's bottom-left corner — rolling/weekly/monthly progress with a hover card, plus a Beijing-time DeepSeek peak-hour timeline.
description.zh: 在 Web 侧边栏左下角显示 OpenCode Go 用量——滚动/本周/本月配额进度与悬停明细卡片，并附按北京时间标记的 DeepSeek 高峰时段进度条。

description.en: China A-share stock research: ticker search, announcements over any date range, financial report cards, valuation profiles and signal-factor explanations (~5,000 stocks since 2011, public read-only data service), plus a link-out tool to an external trading-sandbox product.
description.zh: A股个股研究：搜股票、查任意区间公告、财报卡、估值画像与交易信号科普（约 5000 只、2011 年至今，公共只读数据服务），另有一个跳转外部交易推演产品的链接工具。

description.en: Bridges Multica to DeepSeek Harness through a versioned JSONL process protocol.
description.zh: 通过版本化 JSONL 进程协议将 Multica 接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Native image attachments for text-only DeepSeek in the Web GUI: pasted or dropped images appear as thumbnails in the session, and before dispatch the host reads them with the free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash vision API (glm-4v-flash fallback chain) and substitutes the description, so DeepSeek answers about the image while the original is kept in history.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 提供原生图片上传体验：在 Web GUI 粘贴/拖入图片即以缩略图附件进入会话，发送前由 host 用免费智谱 GLM-4V-Flash 视觉 API（glm-4v-flash 降级链）读取并替换为文字描述，DeepSeek 据此回答，原图保留在聊天历史中。

description.en: Skill studio for DeepSeek Harness: visualize every agent skill (name, description, source, nested flag, model/user invocation), view and edit the full SKILL.md body, toggle model/user invocation, and mine DSH session logs to extract reusable personal skills that the agent auto-loads — from the web settings panel and via skillmgr_* / skillmgr_extract_* tools.
description.zh: DSH skill 可视化与管理插件：在设置面板列出全部 skill（含来源、嵌套标记与模型/用户调用状态），查看并编辑 SKILL.md 正文，一键启用/禁用模型与用户调用；并可从会话日志提取可复用内容，沉淀为 agent 可自动加载的个人 skill。提供 skillmgr_list/get/save/policy 及 skillmgr_extract_* 工具。

description.en: WeChat official account AI writing pipeline: six-step article runs (topic, outline, draft, gates, render, images) with a launch brief contract, a hot-topic board with per-item AI digests, RRULE scheduling to the draft box, a workbench UI plus chat tools and a /wewrite command, and fail-closed host approval before any draft-box push.
description.zh: 公众号 AI 写作管线：六步成文（选题、大纲、成稿、门禁、渲染、配图）+ 启动 brief 合同、热榜逐条 AI 速览、RRULE 定时推草稿箱、写作台与对话工具（/wewrite 命令与 @ 引用），推送草稿箱前经宿主审批 fail-closed 确认。

description.en: Turns the latest completed DSH session turn into a shareable vertical recap video: editable five-scene storyboard, host-side privacy redaction, optional AI polish and TTS narration, MP4/WebM export with PNG cover.
description.zh: 把最近一次已完成的 DSH 任务生成为可分享的竖屏战报视频：五幕可编辑故事板、Host 侧脱敏、可选 AI 润色与配音，导出 MP4/WebM 和 PNG 封面。

description.en: Manage, discover, install, update, and uninstall DSH skills as plugins.
description.zh: 类 Codex 插件市场的 DSH 技能管理器。

description.en: Context7 MCP bridge: gives the model up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples through the Context7 MCP server, keyless by default.
description.zh: 接入 Context7 托管 MCP 服务，为 agent 提供随版本更新的库文档查询；默认免密钥可用。

description.en: First-class Git tools for the model: status / diff / log / commit / branch with validated messages and paths - no bare-shell git calls.
description.zh: 一等公民的 Git 工具：status / diff / log / commit / branch，参数与路径校验、零 shell 调用，杜绝注入。

description.en: Delegates a self-contained coding task to the local Claude Code subscription through the official Claude Agent SDK, and adds a session tab with live output, cost and remaining quota.
description.zh: 把自包含的编码任务委派给本机 Claude Code 订阅执行（走官方 Claude Agent SDK），并在会话里新增一个标签页，实时显示输出、费用与剩余额度。

description.en: PDF parsing tools for DSH: pdf_info, pdf_extract_text, and pdf_render_page with dual pdfjs and built-in rendering engines, including system-font rendering for PDFs with non-embedded CJK fonts.
description.zh: DSH 的 PDF 解析工具：pdf_info、pdf_extract_text、pdf_render_page 三件套，pdfjs 与自研渲染器双引擎，未内嵌 CJK 字体的 PDF 也能用系统字体渲染出图。

description.en: Semantic repo index: tree-sitter symbol search across 8 languages (incl. C/C++), plus a bounded repo map ranked by import-graph PageRank that auto-updates in the system prompt.
description.zh: 语义仓库索引：基于 tree-sitter 的跨 8 种语言（含 C/C++）符号搜索与排名，以及注入系统提示词、按 import-graph PageRank 排序的限量自动更新仓库地图。

description.en: Native Search1API (s1) web research tools: search, news, page crawling, sitemap discovery, and trending topics as first-class `s1_*` tools, with a bundled s1 skill.
description.zh: Search1API（s1）原生联网检索工具：网页搜索、新闻、页面抓取、站点地图与趋势榜，以 `s1_*` 一等工具形式提供，并附带 s1 技能。

description.en: Firecrawl-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key and result limits.
description.zh: 基于 Firecrawl 的网页搜索提供方：替换内置 web_search 的后端，并提供 API Key、结果数量等字段的设置卡片。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness automatically opens browser plugins and includes a built-in WebView2 program to achieve a lightweight desktop experience.
description.zh: deepseek harness自动打开浏览器插件，内置WebView2程序实现轻量级桌面化。

description.en: Agent-managed procedural memory: a skill_manage tool that creates, patches, disables and deletes the agent's own skills in user or project scope, with delete guards (agent-created marker, pin, path confinement) and a trigger-discipline prompt.
description.zh: 代理自管的程序性记忆：skill_manage 工具可创建、修补、禁用、删除 agent 自己的技能（用户级/项目级双作用域），带删除守卫（agent 创建标记、pin、路径限制）与触发纪律提示。

description.en: Publish TXT, Markdown, HTML, PDF, Word, and PowerPoint files as ShareOne links with passwords, watermarks, text-page updates, and TXT/Markdown/HTML comments.
description.zh: 将 TXT、Markdown、HTML、PDF、Word 和 PowerPoint 文件发布为 ShareOne 分享链接，支持访问密码、水印、文本页面更新和 TXT/Markdown/HTML 评论。

description.en: Full-screen lightbox for chat images with zoom, drag pan, download, and keyboard or touch navigation.
description.zh: 聊天图片全屏查看器：点击对话中的图片打开灯箱，支持缩放、拖拽平移、滚轮缩放、文件名显示、下载保存，以及键盘方向键与移动端滑动切换。

description.en: Firecrawl MCP bridge: hosted Firecrawl MCP server with keyless search, scrape and parse; an API key unlocks the full tool surface including crawl and map.
description.zh: 接入 Firecrawl 托管 MCP 服务：免密钥即可使用搜索、抓取与解析（有每日额度），配置 API Key 后解锁完整工具集，含爬取与站点地图。

description.en: LAN/internet reverse-proxy gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: keeps dsh on loopback, exposes 0.0.0.0 with login + HMAC cookie for non-LAN sources (LAN and loopback are proxied without a password by default), optional self-signed or custom TLS, and a Settings card. Includes an insecure-origin UUID shim so workspaces open over plain-HTTP LAN addresses.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的局域网/公网反向代理网关：dsh 仍绑定回环，本插件在 0.0.0.0 提供登录+HMAC Cookie（仅对非局域网来源生效，局域网与回环来源默认免密直连）、可选自签名或自定义 TLS 与官方设置页卡片。自带不安全源 UUID shim，让局域网纯 HTTP 地址也能正常打开工作区。

description.en: A QR-code button above Settings that lets phones connect to the web UI through an auth-gated reverse proxy.
description.zh: 「设置」按钮上方的一键二维码，让手机通过带鉴权的反向代理连接 Web 界面。

description.en: Persistent provider-reported token usage totals with per-session, per-model, and daily activity statistics.
description.zh: 持久化 provider 上报的 Token 用量统计，支持按会话、按模型和按日活跃度查看。

description.en: Connects ChatGPT accounts through OAuth, switches among them manually or automatically, and adds Codex models with usage limits to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 连接 ChatGPT 账号，支持手动或自动切换，并为 DeepSeek Harness 添加带用量限额信息的 Codex 模型。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Markdown 文档与工作空间文件浏览器右侧预览插件 (支持查看/切换隐藏文件与点文件、工作区文件树、文件夹创建与文件移动、JSON 交互结构树/格式化、Java/C++/Python/JS/TS/YAML/Go/Rust 多语言语法高亮与符号大纲、自动换行与多标签 FileTabs)
Package and install code-server (the web version of VSCode) as a plugin within dsh to quickly achieve professional file editing.
description.zh: 将code-server（VSCode网页版）打包安装到dsh内的插件，快速实现专业的文件编辑。

description.en: Model Capability Manager for DSH Web: thinking levels, context window, output caps, input modalities, gateway compat presets, EN/中文 UI.
description.zh: DSH 网页端模型能力管理插件：控制推理档位、上下文与输出上限、输入模态及网关兼容预设，双语界面。

description.en: Connect a sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness: OpenAI-compatible multi-provider routes (OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini) behind one base URL, with per-key model discovery, usage lookup, and global vision/image tools.
description.zh: 将 sub2api 网关接入 DeepSeek Harness：用一个 base URL 统一管理 OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini 等多供应商路由，支持按 key 发现模型、用量查询与全局视觉/图像生成工具。

description.en: Project .pack.json/.pack.zip into .agent-pack/modpacks/ and expose skills via a workspace allow-list.
description.zh: 把 .pack.json/.pack.zip 投影到 .agent-pack/modpacks/，按工作区白名单暴露 skill。

description.en: Read-only repo bootstrap scanner (repo_setup_scan tool): detects stack/tests/docs/git/db and recommends plugins, MCP servers and hygiene files.
description.zh: 只读仓库体检引导工具（repo_setup_scan）：识别技术栈/测试/文档/git/数据库线索，给出插件、MCP 与卫生文件的安装建议。

description.en: Rules, commands & skills manager for dsh: /rules slash command, settings panel with visual rule editing (add/edit/disable/delete, free-zone support), user-defined custom commands with {input} arguments, skill management, and automatic backup & one-click restore of AGENTS.md.
description.zh: dsh 规则、命令与技能管理：/rules 斜杠命令、设置面板可视化编辑规则（增改禁用删除、自由区域支持）、带参数的自定义命令、技能管理、AGENTS.md 自动备份与一键恢复。

description.en: One-click OpenAI-compatible API (CodeBuddy/vLLM/proxies) with thinking mode, avoiding developer-role content_filter rejection.
description.zh: 一键接入 OpenAI 兼容 API（CodeBuddy、vLLM、各类代理）并开启思考模式，绕开第三方端点以 content_filter 拒绝 developer 角色的问题。

description.en: Mobile adapter for the DSH web shell: overlay sidebar/details drawers, responsive composer and settings below 768px, zero desktop regression.
description.zh: DSH Web 移动端适配插件：侧边栏/详情抽屉浮层化、输入栏与设置页响应式适配，桌面零回归。

description.en: Adds an input-modality selector to custom model settings in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的自定义模型设置添加输入模态选择器。

description.en: Inspect and simulate DSH context consumption with trajectory and inventory views, and create, inject, import, or safely repair session messages through the integrated Message Forge.
description.zh: 上下文控制台：通过轨迹墙与库存视图检查并模拟 DSH 上下文消费，并由内置消息锻造台创建、注入、导入或安全修复会话消息。

description.en: Model Health panel in Settings: lists every model configured in settings.yaml and batch-tests availability and latency for each.
description.zh: 设置页「模型健康」面板：列出 settings.yaml 配置的全部模型，一键批量测试可用性与延迟。

description.en: Current-session message outline rail for the DSH web UI — your messages show as slim bars on the left edge; hover to expand the full outline (line number + text), click to jump instantly to that message. Pure frontend, zero external service dependencies, sessions-snapshot driven with zero polling.
description.zh: 当前会话消息大纲（左缘横杠）——你的消息在对话区左缘显示一列细横杠，hover 展开完整大纲（行号+文本），点击瞬间定位到对话里那条消息。纯前端、零外部服务依赖、sessions 快照驱动零轮询。

description.en: DSH Usage Monitor: auto-query provider credit balances and time-window limits from configured API keys, with input capsule and custom provider support.
description.zh: DSH 用量监控：自动查询已配置 API Key 的供应商余额和时间窗口限制，支持输入框余量胶囊和自定义供应商。

description.en: Give DeepSeek (text-only) models vision in Claude Code, Codex, and Agent Plugins clients: describe images via any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint.

A `/backstory` command and tool that annotate each line with the git commit that last touched it and the agent turn + prompt that wrote it, from a persistent per-line ledger (drift-proof by content hash), DSH-* commit trailers, or the live session log.
description.zh: /backstory 命令与工具：为每一行标注最后改动它的 git 提交，以及写下它的 agent 轮次与提示词；数据取自按行持久化的账本（以内容哈希防漂移）、DSH-* 提交尾注或实时会话日志。

description.en: Library-only Cordis plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness terminal presentation and interaction

Media and vision workspace for DeepSeek Harness: image, video and speech generation, image Q&A and element locating, long-image OCR, pixel diff, HTML-screenshot verification and video summarization, with DashScope and OpenAI-compatible providers, model pools and a workbench client.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的媒体与视觉工作台：文生图、图/文生视频、语音合成与转写、图像问答与元素定位、长图 OCR、像素比对、HTML 截图验证、视频摘要；支持 DashScope 与 OpenAI 兼容供应商，含模型池与工作台客户端。

description.en: Switch the current DSH session's model with a natural-language sentence, on web, TUI, or IM bridges (WeChat, Feishu), without touching the panel.
description.zh: 用一句自然语言切换当前 DSH 会话模型，可在 Web、TUI 及 IM 桥接的微信、飞书等对话框中使用，无需操作面板。

description.en: One-click standalone two-column code review page for Git diffs in the conversation: line numbers, add/delete coloring, character-level highlight, hunk-aware per-file sections, a file nav sidebar and a stats bar; line comments submit back to the DSH composer, and the UI follows the DSH locale.
description.zh: 把对话里的 git diff 一键打开为独立标签页的双列代码评审页：行号、增删配色、字符级高亮、hunk 感知的多文件分段、文件导航侧栏与统计条，行内评论可提交回 DSH 对话框，界面跟随 DSH 语言（中英）。

description.en: Vision provider route that transcribes attached images to text through a configurable model (15+ OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic vendors) while DeepSeek keeps answering.
description.zh: 视觉模型路由：把附加图片经可配置模型（15+ OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic 供应商）转译为文字，对话仍由 DeepSeek 作答。

description.en: During long agent thinking, posts a hot-news or reminder message directly into the conversation stream.
description.zh: agent 思考超时时，直接在对话流中推出一条今日头条热点或提醒消息。

description.en: Card-style plugin manager in Settings: enable/disable each plugin through the profile patch layer, install-source details, npm update check with one-click update, uninstall, search, and load-error badges.
description.zh: 设置页卡片式插件管理：经 profile 补丁层启停插件（跨重启保留）、安装来源详情、npm 更新检查与一键更新、卸载、搜索与加载失败标识。

description.en: Sidebar panel for account balances and local token usage, with provider/model breakdowns and a 27-week daily heatmap.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板展示账户余额与本地 Token 用量，包含供应商/模型明细和 27 周每日热力图。

description.en: Run Stata through DeepSeek Harness: the native Stata AI Skill service auto-starts with DSH (macOS/Windows binaries bundled), so you can run regressions, do-files and econometrics workflows with no manual setup.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中运行 Stata：Stata AI Skill 原生服务随 DSH 自动启动（内置 macOS/Windows 多平台二进制），无需手动配置即可跑回归、do 文件与计量工作流。

description.en: 跨工具（Cursor / WorkBuddy / Claude Code 等）的 SKILL.md 技能管理器与 Rules 规则管理器（含远程规则导入），TypeScript 零运行时依赖实现
Agent-driven kanban board: one board per workspace, per-task agent sessions, and a guarded human/agent workflow (Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done).
description.zh: agent 驱动的看板：每个工作区一块看板、每个任务一个 agent 会话，以及带护栏的人机协作流程（Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness memory and knowledge hub that routes update, retrieve, and subscribe calls across compatible plugins, with an optional transactional Rust backend.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的记忆与知识中台：在兼容插件之间路由 update、retrieve 和 subscribe 调用，并提供可选的事务化 Rust 后端。

description.en: Sidebar session-title icons: an auxiliary model call on the same route as title generation draws a 24x24 monochrome SVG metaphor shown before each session row title, with disk caching.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话标题图标：标题生成时用同一路由的辅助模型调用画一枚 24×24 单色 SVG 隐喻图标，显示在每行标题左侧，带磁盘缓存。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance in the dsh web sidebar footer with live config hot reload and an editable Settings → Plugins card.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏底部展示 DeepSeek 账户余额，支持配置热重载与可编辑的设置 → 插件卡片。

description.en: dsh 启动保险丝：社区插件不兼容导致 dsh 启动失败时，自动禁用坏插件并重试
Metaso (秘塔AI搜索) search & reader providers for the web seam: web_search returns page summaries, web_fetch reads full-page markdown, multi-scope search (webpage/document/paper/image/video/podcast).
description.zh: 秘塔AI搜索 providers for ctx.web：web_search 返回网页摘要，web_fetch 读取网页全文 markdown，多范围搜索（网页/文库/论文/图片/视频/播客）。

description.en: Floating, browser-local whale arcade with three score games and ocean-themed Gomoku for breaks while waiting on the agent.
description.zh: 浏览器本地运行的悬浮鲸鱼游戏中心，包含三款积分游戏和海洋主题五子棋，适合等待 Agent 时随手游玩。

description.en: A fully customizable theming framework for DSH UI, with Xiao from Genshin Impact as the default theme.
description.zh: 为 DSH UI 提供完全自定义的主题框架，默认主题为原神魈。

description.en: Floating widget showing real-time OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling/weekly/monthly) for every API key, with rate-limit alerts and automatic key-pool discovery.
description.zh: 悬浮组件实时显示 OpenCode Go 各 key 用量（滚动/每周/每月），限流预警，自动发现 key 池。

description.en: COM-driven real Microsoft Office automation for DeepSeek Harness: drives a running Excel/Word instance through OfficeMCP — VBA macros, pivot tables, live formula recalculation, and deep document layout; plus an accounting suite (double-entry journal posting with debit/credit balance check, and SUMIF general ledger).
description.zh: COM 驱动真实 Microsoft Office 实例的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：经 OfficeMCP 操作运行中的 Excel/Word——VBA 宏、透视表、活公式重算、文档深度排版；含会计场景（复式记账分录 + 借贷平衡校验、SUMIF 科目总账）。

description.en: Multi-candidate mode for DeepSeek Harness (test-time scaling): floating panel config, the agent auto-runs parallel candidates plus verifier selection, scoped to the current session.
description.zh: 多候选模式插件（test-time scaling）：悬浮球面板配置，模型对任务自动执行并行候选加验证选优，仅当前会话生效。

description.en: Arknights-inspired fan skin for the DSH Web UI featuring Pramanix and Eyjafjalla in a day/night celestial garden.
description.zh: DSH Web 明日方舟同人皮肤“初雪和小羊”，包含昼夜星海庭园背景与双角色布局。

description.en: Renders pasted/uploaded images inline in the DSH Web chat and gives text-only models vision: the model-invokable visual_review tool calls any OpenAI-compatible multimodal API first, falling back to a local Qwen3-VL worker.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 聊天界面内联渲染粘贴/上传的图片，并让纯文本模型“看见”图片：visual_review 工具优先调用任意 OpenAI 兼容多模态 API，未配置时回退本机 Qwen3-VL。

description.en: Persistent background watchers that wake the agent on new messages (file inbox or command-output delta) — the harness analog of Claude Code's Monitor tool.
description.zh: 常驻后台监视器：文件收件箱（NDJSON）或命令输出增量一到就唤醒 agent，相当于 Claude Code Monitor 工具的 Harness 实现。

description.en: Sync the installed DeepSeek Harness plugin manifest to a GitHub Gist (OAuth login, one-click export/import with automatic dependency install).
description.zh: 将已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件清单同步到 GitHub Gist（OAuth 登录、一键导出/导入并自动安装依赖）。

description.en: Self-learning loop for dsh: record lessons, draft and promote skills, periodic curator review that corrects, consolidates, and retires skills.
description.zh: dsh 自我学习闭环：记录经验、生成并发布技能，定期审查修正、合并与退役技能。

description.en: Scheduled tasks panel for managing DSH agent and system crontabs with natural language input and execution logs.
description.zh: 定时任务面板：分区管理 DSH 与系统 crontab、自然语言生成表达式、执行日志与完成后消息推送。

description.en: Mobile pairing remote for DeepSeek Harness: E2EE companion over dual-plane allowlisted RPC (LAN, Tailscale, optional Cloudflare Quick Tunnel or self-hosted rendezvous).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 移动配对远程插件：双平面白名单 RPC 上的端到端加密 Companion（局域网、Tailscale，可选 Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 或自建 rendezvous）。

description.en: Connects DSH to local Beav for Xiaohongshu (RED/RedNote) and social-media AI operations: topic research, knowledge, copywriting, image, audio, and short-video workflows with approval and artifact tracking.
description.zh: 将 DSH 连接到本机 Beav，面向小红书（RED/RedNote）、社交媒体运营和自媒体 AI 创作，覆盖选题研究、知识库、文案、图片、音频与短视频工作流，并保留审批和产物追踪。

description.en: Prompt library above the DSH composer — a 📚 button expands a searchable panel to insert saved prompts into the draft with one click (appends, never overwrites), persisted in a host-side JSON file.
description.zh: 输入框上方的提示词库：📚 按钮展开可搜索面板，点条目一键填入草稿（追加不覆盖）；数据以 JSON 文件保存在 Host 侧。

description.en: Per-execution HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy routing for Agent fetches, LLM providers, and shell commands, with settings-backed hot reload, approval-gated controls, and credential-safe status.
description.zh: 按每次执行为 Agent fetch、LLM provider 与 shell 命令路由 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理；支持 settings 热更新、审批门禁和凭据安全状态。

description.en: Read-only insight panel for one profile: five views over the same data — config layers, plugin tree, services, tool names and models — each entry showing which layer inserted or disabled it and whether it is running.
description.zh: 只读的 profile 洞察面板：同一份数据的五个视图——配置层、插件树、服务、工具名、模型，每一条都给出被哪一层插入或禁用、此刻在不在跑。

description.en: Import local Codex CLI/Desktop, Claude Code CLI, and Claude Desktop conversations into DSH with project grouping, semantic history, and tool activity; bind an existing or replacement workspace and continue with the DSH Agent.
description.zh: 将本地 Codex CLI/Desktop、Claude Code CLI 和 Claude Desktop 会话导入 DSH：按项目分组，保留语义历史和工具活动，可绑定原工作区或新工作区，并由 DSH Agent 继续对话。

description.en: Smooth comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing comet trail replaces the native blinking caret and glides across the input as you type, with configurable accent color, thickness, and trail, IME-aware for CJK input.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供流畅的彗星光标：以发光的彗星拖尾取代原生闪烁光标，随输入平滑滑动，可配置强调色、粗细与拖尾，并适配中文等 IME 输入。

description.en: Registers the commercial-ui-ux skill for DSH: task-aware commercial UI/UX/GUI design, review, repair, and implementation (SaaS, dashboards, admin panels, forms, tables, design systems) with a reference-doc system and quality gates.
description.zh: 注册 commercial-ui-ux 技能：以任务为中心的商业界面 UI/UX/GUI 设计、审查、修复与实现（SaaS、仪表盘、后台、表单、表格、设计系统），带参考文档体系与质量门禁。

description.en: Markdown viewer for the dock workbench: GFM rendering with DOMPurify sanitization, document outline and relative-path image/link resolution, with one-click switch to editing.
description.zh: dock 系列 Markdown 查看器：GFM 渲染 + DOMPurify 消毒、文档大纲、相对路径图片/链接解析，可一键切换编辑。

description.en: DSH 手机远程访问 + 远程桌面：内置本地代理(8090)+配置面板+远程屏幕/鼠标/键盘。配合任意内网穿透工具（cpolar/frp/ngrok等）把公网URL转发到 127.0.0.1:8090 即可用手机浏览器远程使用本机 Harness。自动安装配套的 dsh-browser-polyfill。
Prompt-cache diagnostics dashboard showing provider-reported token usage, adjacent logical-input changes, and Call TTFT.
description.zh: 提示词缓存诊断页，展示 Provider 回传的 Token 用量、相邻逻辑输入变化与 Call TTFT。

description.en: Skill and MCP management center for DeepSeek Harness: browse and toggle user/project skills, add/edit/remove MCP servers hot without restart, with live per-session status in the sidebar.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能与 MCP 管理中心：浏览并启停用户/项目技能，热增删改 MCP 服务器（免重启），侧边栏实时展示各服务器状态。

description.en: Token usage and cost metering for dsh: per-session and aggregate statistics with configurable pricing and reports.
description.zh: dsh 用量计量：会话级与汇总 token 统计、可配置计价与报告。

description.en: Security and governance for dsh: rule-based tool denial, full tool-call audit trail, and governance reports.
description.zh: dsh 安全治理：规则化工具拦截、完整工具调用审计轨迹与治理报告。

description.en: Native A2A (Agent-to-Agent) server for dsh: expose this dsh as a callable agent over HTTP with JSON-RPC tasks.
description.zh: dsh 原生 A2A 服务：通过 HTTP JSON-RPC 将本 dsh 暴露为可调用的代理。

description.en: Import Claude Code sessions, skills and plugin assets into DSH as native resumable sessions, and export or sync DSH sessions back to Claude Code JSONL.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code 会话、技能与插件资产导入为 DSH 原生可续聊会话，并支持将 DSH 会话导出或同步回 Claude Code JSONL。

description.en: Read-only SonarQube Community Build tools: instance status, project Quality Gate for a branch or pull request, issue and Security Hotspot search, single hotspot detail, and coverage, duplication or caller-selected measures. Issue and hotspot results carry a normalized location with component key, file path, line and text range.
description.zh: 面向 SonarQube Community Build 的只读工具：实例状态、分支或 PR 的项目质量阈、议题与安全热点搜索、单个热点详情，以及覆盖率、重复率或调用方指定的度量项。议题与热点结果附带标准化的位置信息，包含组件 key、文件路径、行号与文本范围。

description.en: Agent phone client plugin — phone dialer overlay in DSH web UI, consuming CHA2A phone directory
Codex-style auto-hiding right-edge turn rail: edge-peek show/hide, per-turn tooltip, in-rail search, and a scrolling 30-turn window for long sessions.
description.zh: Codex 风格自动隐藏右缘轮次导航：靠边浮现、单轮 tooltip、会话内搜索、长会话 30 轮滚动窗口。

description.en: Claude-Code-style lifecycle hooks: configured shell commands run before/after model tool calls with a JSON payload on stdin; a non-zero pre-tool exit blocks the call.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格生命周期 hooks：工具调用前后自动执行 shell 命令（stdin 收 JSON payload），pre-tool 非零退出即阻断调用。

description.en: Auto-discovery vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: automatically finds an image-capable model from your configured providers and returns picture descriptions as plain text via a vision tool.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek Harness 主模型搭视觉桥：自动从已配置模型中挑选多模态模型，通过 vision 工具把图片描述以纯文本返回。

description.en: Steam-style plugin storefront: a plugin registry browsable inside DSH with one-click install, uninstall and update, plus a zero-dependency CLI and agent-callable market tools.
description.zh: Steam 风格的插件商店：在 DSH 里浏览插件注册表，一键安装、卸载与更新，另有零依赖 CLI 与可供 agent 调用的市场工具。

description.en: Windows system-level notifications when the agent finishes a task or needs your input: task-done, question, approval and plan-review alerts via the browser Notification API, click-to-open the session, background-only mode, and a first-level settings page (Settings → 任务提示).
description.zh: 任务完成或需要你输入/批准时弹出 Windows 系统通知（浏览器 Notification API）：完成/提问/审批/计划审阅提醒，点击气泡直达会话，支持后台模式，设置页在官方设置 → 任务提示。

description.en: Bridge DeepSeek Harness (dsh) into Feishu / Lark with streaming cards, project workspaces, approvals and scheduling
Session insights and one-click shareable HTML replay for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话洞察，并可一键导出为可分享的 HTML 回放。

description.en: DSH Companion 鲸鱼 Skill/CLI 插件前端（dual-face Cordis 插件）
Pre-visit due diligence and company research in DeepSeek Harness for customer background checks and risk briefs, with Qichacha MCP tool-call budget approval and entity confirmation.
description.zh: 访前尽调智能体：面向拜访前调查，提供企业尽调、客户尽调、客户背景调查、工商核验与风险信息整理；使用企查查 MCP，设有调用预算授权和主体确认。

description.en: Host-neutral durable DAG workflows for Agents with CLI, MCP, on-demand Skills, triggers, replay, and a visual Canvas.
description.zh: 面向 Agent 的 Host-neutral 持久化 DAG 工作流，提供 CLI、MCP、按需 Skill、Trigger、重放和可视化 Canvas。

description.en: Approval sound effects from the movie NiuLai: plays 「妈妈」 when user confirmation is requested, interrupts it and plays 「牛来！」 the moment the user approves; native Windows playback, zero external dependencies.
description.zh: 牛来确认音：请求用户确认时播放「妈妈」，批准瞬间掐断并播放「牛来！」；梗源电影《牛来》，Windows 原生播放，零外部依赖。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 逐轮产出物卡片插件:每一轮(assistant 回答下方)显示该轮真正产出的文件与网址,精确按轮归属、只认非只读工具写/改/展示内容,撤回(截断)该轮后卡片随轮消失;卡片可一键用默认程序打开、在侧边栏预览或打开所在位置
Labnana image generation for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image / image-to-image / precise editing with credits estimation, subscription balance and web settings UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Labnana 图片生成：文生图 / 图生图 / 精准编辑，含积分预估、余额查询与网页设置界面。

description.en: Lets a text-only DeepSeek agent read images in the same session by delegating to a vision-capable subagent, with send-time image-to-path conversion.
description.zh: 让纯文本 DeepSeek 代理在同一会话内读图：委派给视觉子代理，发送时自动把图片转为文件路径。

description.en: Honcho memory plugin by Plastic Labs: injects the user profile, session summary and relevant conclusions at session start, uploads each turn to Honcho in the background with secrets redacted, and adds honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember tools plus a /honcho status command; configured through the ~/.honcho/config.json shared with the other Honcho integrations, against hosted honcho.dev or a self-hosted instance.
description.zh: 由 Plastic Labs 维护的 Honcho 记忆插件：会话启动时注入用户画像、会话摘要与相关结论，后台脱敏后逐轮上传对话到 Honcho，提供 honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember 工具及 /honcho 状态命令；通过与其他 Honcho 集成共用的 ~/.honcho/config.json 配置，支持托管的 honcho.dev 或自建实例。

description.en: Liquid Glass refraction input card for the DSH web GUI, with coupled-spring press animation. Published on npm: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liquid-glass-input.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 输入卡加上液态玻璃折射效果与弹簧按压动画。已发布 npm：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liquid-glass-input。

description.en: Draggable floating cat-or-dog companion for the dsh web GUI that changes expression with the session and is configured on a Companion settings page.
description.zh: 可拖拽的猫狗悬浮伴侣，表情随当前会话变化，在 Companion 设置页里换皮肤。

description.en: Shut down Windows automatically after DeepSeek Harness tasks complete — a floating arm button plus a cancellable countdown banner (shutdown /a), zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 任务完成后自动关机：右下角按钮开启模式，任务成功完成后进入可取消的倒计时（取消走 shutdown /a），零运行时依赖。

description.en: Test-stability tools: repeatedly run vitest/jest/pytest/node:test suites, classify flaky cases, keep history, maintain a quarantine manifest and health self-check.
description.zh: 测试稳定性工具：重复运行 vitest/jest/pytest/node:test，识别 flaky 用例，历史留档、隔离清单与健康自检。

description.en: Plays a chime and speaks a Chinese voice alert when an approval, question, or plan-review popup appears in the DSH web GUI, so you never miss a request.

description.en: Reverse tunnel for the DSH Web GUI: exposes a `dsh --profile web` deployment at a public frp URL and switches the directory picker to the in-app browser, so a phone or remote machine can open and manage the workspace.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 反向隧道：通过 frp 把 `dsh --profile web` 发布到公网地址，目录选择器改用应用内浏览器，手机或远程机器可直接打开并管理工作区。

description.en: Unified model routing for DeepSeek Harness: one logical ModelID over multiple providers with first-token failover and cooldown, health-aware candidate ranking, three tiers (tier1/tier2/tier3) auto-selected by purpose, per-candidate reasoning effort, and a settings-page management panel.
description.zh: 统一模型路由：一个逻辑 ModelID 汇聚多家供应商，首 token 前失败自动切换并冷却、健康度择优、按 purpose 三档分级（tier1/2/3）、每候选思考级别，设置面板自动保存即时生效。

description.en: Deterministic code security review: 40+ rules, secret entropy detection, staged-diff review, SARIF export, baseline acceptance, SBOM-lite dependency inventory and health self-check.
description.zh: 确定性代码安全审查：40+ 规则、密钥熵检测、staged diff 审查、SARIF 导出、基线接受、SBOM-lite 依赖清单与健康自检。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek account balance and current-session token and cost usage in the sidebar footer and composer dock, including peak and off-peak billing and subagent consumption.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部和输入框上方显示你的 DeepSeek 账户余额与当前会话 token 及费用消耗，支持高峰/空闲峰谷计费与子代理消耗统计。

description.en: Composer GitHub picker: click the GitHub icon at the bottom-right of the input box to search the workspace repository's issues and pull requests via the gh CLI, and insert the reference as a URL or @owner/repo#number mention.
description.zh: 输入框右下角 GitHub 图标打开当前仓库的 issue/PR 搜索弹窗，数据来自本机 gh CLI，点选即以 URL 或 @owner/repo#number 形式插入引用。

description.en: Bridges the LiuHe MCP code toolkit (44 tools) into dsh web: repo_map, symbol search, edit_batch with tolerant matching, transactional edits with undo journal, and deterministic quality gates — backed by a crash-isolated Rust tree-sitter parse daemon and SQLite index.
description.zh: 将 LiuHe MCP 代码工具集（44 个工具）桥接进 dsh web：repo_map、符号搜索、带容错匹配的 edit_batch、带撤销日志的事务性编辑，以及确定性质量门禁——由崩溃隔离的 Rust tree-sitter 解析守护进程和 SQLite 索引支撑。

description.en: Transport-level authentication gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with server-side sessions, HttpOnly cookies, IP-based login throttling, and an scrypt password CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的传输层认证门禁，提供服务端会话、HttpOnly Cookie、基于 IP 的登录限流及 scrypt 口令 CLI。

description.en: Rearranges DSH Web into a three-column workbench with file editing, Git views, Markdown preview, and workspace terminals.
description.zh: 将 DSH Web 重排为三栏工作台，提供文件编辑、Git 视图、Markdown 预览和工作区终端。

description.en: Git sidebar panel with commit graphs, ahead/behind tracking, branch operations, and one-click chat context injection.
description.zh: Git 侧边栏面板：提交图谱、超前/落后跟踪、分支操作及改动 Diff 一键带入对话。

description.en: Plugin quality scorecard for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 with grade, 6 components, fix suggestions per deduction, batch leaderboard - CLI plus an agent-callable quality_score tool.

description.en: Paste non-image files or folders into the chat composer as native @path references, or drag them in as absolute paths, instead of the images-only error.

description.en: Monitoring and alerting tools for DeepSeek Harness: Prometheus queries, targets, alerts, rules, series, labels, metric metadata, TSDB, config and runtime status, discovered Alertmanagers, Alertmanager, Loki LogQL, Grafana dashboards, admin stats, plugins,

description.en: Brings the codebase knowledge-base capability of langchain-ai/openwiki into DSH — one-click generate/read/update of the repository Wiki, Grounded Claims (source-traced knowledge cards) and a project knowledge base built from uploaded local files, reusing the model DSH already has configured, with no second API key.

description.en: Freshness gate for the agent's test, typecheck, lint and build claims: each verification run becomes a receipt on tools/post-execute, file edits are tracked, and on agent/turn-stopping a claim whose latest receipt is stale, failed or has no readable result steers one more step naming the receipt and the files edited since.
description.zh: 为智能体的测试、类型检查、lint 与构建结论提供新鲜度检查：每次验证运行在 tools/post-execute 上记录为凭据，文件修改被跟踪；在 agent/turn-stopping 时，若结论对应的最新凭据已过期、失败或没有可读结果，则引导再走一步，并指出凭据与其后被修改的文件。

description.en: GitHub-style daily token-usage heatmap on the new-session screen with a selectable calendar-year view, green/blue color schemes, and today / this-month / all-time totals.

description.en: Hand a DSH web session to the locally installed Claude Code CLI: a per-session engine selector (DSH | Claude Code), Claude models and reasoning effort in the model seat, Claude permission modes in place of the access-mode selector, and permission requests, AskUserQuestion and ExitPlanMode routed to the native DSH approval, question and plan-review cards. The stream is written as native DSH session events, so the built-in transcript, tool cards and nested subagents render it; Claude slash commands merge into the command palette; the CLI is held by a detached broker, so plugin updates and DSH restarts do not interrupt a running turn.
description.zh: 把一个 dsh web 会话交给本机 Claude Code CLI 驱动：输入框内的引擎选择器（DSH | Claude Code）按会话切换，模型座换成 Claude 的模型与 reasoning effort，访问模式换成 Claude 权限档；权限请求、AskUserQuestion、ExitPlanMode 分别接到 dsh 原生的审批卡、提问卡与计划审核卡。Claude 的流写成 dsh 原生会话事件，由内建转录、工具卡片与嵌套子 agent 渲染；斜杠命令并入命令面板；CLI 由独立 broker 持有，插件更新与 dsh 重启都不中断进行中的轮次。

description.en: LMA (Layered Memory Architecture) 是一个为 DeepSeek Harness 设计的地基插件（Foundation Plugin）。它定义了 “记忆体（Memory Body）” 这一抽象概念及其挂载/卸载协议。  它与其他记忆插件的本质区别在于：LMA 是一个容器和载体，让 dsh-memory-evolve、EchoCore 等“能力性插件”可以挂载其上，它本身也内置了一套可开关的基础记忆流程，作为可选能力。LMA结束记忆功能的“一锅乱炖”，实现跨会话的结构化记忆机制。(目前功能还在持续完善以及测试，对于其他插件的接口在构想完整后逐步推动)

DeepSeek Harness 多模型路由插件：让专业的事情交给专业的 agent——自定义视觉/翻译/语音/子代理等专业 agent 并绑定独立模型，多模态账号一键登录、账号池健康路由与实时用量统计

description.en: Bridge your pi extension, codex plugin or claude code plugin to dsh (DeepSeek Harness)
description.zh: 将 Pi、Codex、Claude Code 插件桥接到 DeepSeek Harness，一站式安装管理各类智能体插件。

description.en: Local personality, memory and distillation layer for DeepSeek Harness — SOUL/IDENTITY/USER/STATE persona files, cross-session memory and LLM distillation, auto-loaded on startup.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Persistent identity layer for DeepSeek Harness. The first reference implementation of AI Soul.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上持久化的灵魂层，让 AI 的身份、记忆和成长独立于模型存在。

description.en: DSH Web annotation/quote plugin (fork enhanced)
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中选中助手消息文字即可引用，可加备注或留空，本地增强版更顺手。

description.en: Lets the DSH web UI attach files of any type as pathless @-mentions: pick a workspace file from the @ menu or drop one into the composer, and the agent reads it directly.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 APEX 实验插件：Minimal 锚定启动、按需 Standard 工具、持久任务状态与 V4 Flash 定向研究。
description.zh: APEX preset for DeepSeek Harness with a Minimal anchor, lean guidance, and on-demand Standard tools

description.en: AI approval answerer for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) using the unified LLM route with fail-closed policy checks.
description.zh: AI approval answerer for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) using the unified LLM route with fail-closed policy checks.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件:侧边栏「已归档」面板,可查看/打开/取消归档会话 A side panel that lists, opens, and unarchives archived sessions.
description.zh: 在侧边栏快速查看、打开或取消归档历史会话，方便找回和管理旧对话。

description.en: 火山方舟订阅套餐剩余额度 DSH 侧边栏小组件（宿主代理 GetCodingPlanUsage + 浏览器 widget + 免重启 cookie 刷新工具）

description.en: Cooperative timeout guard for ask_user_question: lost or unanswered questions resolve as a structured ASK_TIMEOUT instead of hanging the turn forever.
description.zh: 为 ask_user_question 提供协作式超时守卫：提问卡片丢失或用户未答复时以结构化 ASK_TIMEOUT 结束调用，避免回合无限挂起。

description.en: DSH plugin: fold mis-rendered thinking/reasoning content into collapsible blocks and render mermaid diagrams inline.
description.zh: 把渲染错乱的思考内容折叠起来，并直接在对话中显示 Mermaid 图表，让输出更清爽。

description.en: Cross-platform DSH WebUI multimedia input and workspace attachments
dsh 提醒插件：别错过需要你的时刻
Content-addressed audit indexes across independent DeepSeek Harness evidence producers
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 各证据源生成内容寻址审计索引，方便独立校验与追溯。

description.en: Proactive scheduling: an adaptive heartbeat plus a value network (urgency, relevance, interruption cost) decides when the agent should speak unprompted.
description.zh: 主动调度：自适应心跳 + 价值网络（紧迫度、相关性、打断代价）决定 Agent 何时主动开口。

description.en: Trusted Auto: a middle permission tier for DeepSeek Harness between workspace-write and danger-full-access, auto-approving harmless commands and trusted-area targets
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供介于工作区写入和完全访问之间的中间权限层，自动放行无害命令和可信区域操作，兼顾安全与效率。

description.en: Auto chess: human vs AI, or AI vs AI.
description.zh: 自走棋：人机对战或双 AI 对弈。

description.en: Enhanced auto-compaction defaults for DeepSeek Harness agent presets: apply tuned threshold/retention budgets and per-model policies with one command, idempotent with backups and rollback.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体预设注入增强的自动压缩默认值：一键应用调优的触发阈值/保留比例与分模型策略，幂等执行、自动备份、可回滚。

description.en: Auto maintenance and resilience for DeepSeek Harness: startup self-diagnosis, automatic repair of missing directories, scheduled configuration backups with rotation, one-click restore, smart-start port detection, plugin-change self-check with automatic rollback, startup failure rescue, and a health watchdog that restarts a stuck-but-alive instance. Ships as a Cordis plugin plus a standalone CLI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一体化自动维护与稳定性保障：启动自检、缺失目录自动修复、配置周期备份与轮转、一键还原、智能启动端口检测、插件变更自动自检与回滚、启动失败自动救援，以及自动重启"卡死但存活"实例的健康守护。以 Cordis 插件和独立 CLI 双形态交付。

description.en: Self-update for the harness launcher; checks npm for a newer @deepseek-ai/dsh, stages the tarball, and applies it on harness exit or via update-and-restart from the web panel.
description.zh: Harness 启动器自更新插件；检查 npm 上的 @deepseek-ai/dsh 新版本，暂存 tarball，并在退出或通过面板「更新并重启」时应用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 自动审批插件：在 workspace-write 沙箱之上叠加确定性规则 + LLM 安全审批，自动模式不放宽沙箱、fail-closed。 Safe auto-approval for DeepSeek Harness — deterministic rules + LLM review on top of the workspace-write sandbox. Auto mode without ever granting full-access.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自动审批插件：在 workspace-write 沙箱之上增加 Auto 档——确定性规则放行/拒绝，模糊操作由 LLM 裁决，危险操作转人工。保留工作区沙箱边界，不放宽为 full-access。

description.en: Automatically loads the full conversation history when a session opens, so older messages are ready without clicking "Load earlier".
description.zh: 打开会话时自动加载全部历史消息，免去反复点击「加载更早」。

description.en: Switch between Chat and Agent without leaving your DeepSeek Harness session.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中一键切换聊天和智能体模式，不用打断当前会话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web 背景图片插件:本地图片路径替换网页背景,外观设置行 + 实时预览

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 余额显示插件
一个好看、简单、实用的余额监视器｜DeepSeek Harness 插件：官方余额快照 + ds_balance 工具 + 峰谷计价区间 + Matrix/原生双风格徽章

description.en: Balance, session cost, token usage, and invoice summaries for DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 直接在聊天栏下方显示余额、单次对话花费和Token用量，让你随时摸清AI消费账单。

description.en: DSH 办公文件插件：阅读 PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX，生成 DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/PDF/CSV。A DSH plugin for reading and generating common office files.

Basic Right Sidebar — a right sidebar plugin for DeepSeek Harness: two-level navigation (Functions / Sessions), workspace/session breadcrumb, session overview with log download, native trajectory view, and configurable topbar decluttering.

Bayesian stock prediction plugin that fuses MACD, RSI, moving-average, volume and other technical signals into an up-move posterior probability with multi-horizon comparison, trend-state classification and position risk metrics for A-share and US stocks.
description.zh: 贝叶斯个股预测插件：多指标信号融合的上涨概率估计、趋势状态识别与持仓风险度量（A 股 + 美股）。

description.en: Deterministic revision-pinned benchmarks and regression evidence for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 工具和插件提供可复现、确定性的基准测试证据，方便做回归测试和性能对比。

description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个鲸鱼娘桌宠，随时陪你聊天互动，让开发环境不再枯燥。

description.en: DSH web GUI realtime billing monitor: token/cost metering, DeepSeek v4 peak pricing, balance anchoring, sidebar pill + settings page, billi…
description.zh: 实时计费监控：token/花费计量、V4 峰谷价格。

description.en: Billing and usage inspection plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

Text-first toolset (snapshot/click/type/navigate/tab-stack) with screenshot as visual fallback. Firefox add-on available on AMO. Ported from Lum1104/dsh-browser (MIT).
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控你的 Firefox 标签页，后台静默操作，保留登录状态，无需切换窗口。
