A DeepSeek Harness plugin and AI skill for Figma-style canvas design. Generates, previews, and iterates multi-frame UI drafts directly from chat, storing living design specifications as clean HTML files version-controlled in Git.
Adds session, project, and global controls in the DSH WebUI for skills, MCP servers, tools, prompt injections, approval escalation, and safety guards; enforcement is scoped to the current agent.

description.en: Cat-themed DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin with three original themes and a calm interactive companion. Not an official DeepSeek product.

在聊天界面左侧添加导航栏，快速跳转到任意历史提问，长会话也能轻松回溯。

description.en: Session-header button that cycles the conversation width (748-1600px), widening the chat column, composer, and user bubbles together.
description.zh: 会话标题栏按钮循环切换对话宽度（748–1600px），消息区、输入框、用户气泡同步加宽。

description.zh: 通过官方 OAuth 绑定你的 ChatGPT 账号，在 DSH 内直接使用 ChatGPT 模型对话，消耗 Plus/Pro 订阅额度。

description.en: CI failure, diagnosed before you open the logs — DeepSeek Harness plugin that watches GitHub Actions for new failures and turns raw logs into structured diagnosis cards · CI 失败，打开日志前就完成诊断 —— DSH 插件：监视 GitHub Actions 新失败，原始日志转结构化诊断卡，签名账本识别复发问题
description.zh: CI 故障诊断：盯着 GitHub Actions 新失败，把原始日志翻译成可操作的诊断。

DSH Web UI 手机端适配插件：抽屉式布局、聊天背景+毛玻璃、AI 聊天气泡、消息头像、中英双语（桌面端与原版一致）
用于监控当前会话额度消耗、预估费用及当前API余额/Used to monitor the current session's quota consumption, estimated costs, and current API balance.
description.zh: 用于监控当前会话额度消耗、预估费用及当前API余额/Used to monitor the current session's quota consumption, estimated costs, and current API balance.

description.en: Ringtone notifications for DeepSeek Harness: alerts are triggered when the conversation ends and when authorization is required (either with a built-in tone, TTS voice, or custom audio).  **DeepSeek Harness 网页端铃声提醒插件：回答完成或需要授权时响铃提醒，支持内置铃声 / 文字转语音 / 自定义音频。
description.zh: AI回答完成或需要授权时自动响铃提醒，并弹出提示卡片，让你放心切走干别的。

description.zh: 在网页聊天输入框上方为选中的 AI 回复内容添加可移除的引用横幅，随下一条消息一并发送。

description.en: Cloud workspaces for DeepSeek Harness — pick Cloud (SSH) in the workspace picker and the agent's bash/read/write/edit/glob/grep tools transparently run on your Linux server over SSH. Zero remote install.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接选择 SSH 云端工作区，让智能体的文件操作和命令执行透明地跑在远程 Linux 服务器上，无需本地环境。

description.en: 为deepseek-harness提供一个命令行启动工具，让它 --append-prompt  --resume 等类claude命令
description.zh: 为deepseek-harness提供一个命令行启动工具，让它 --append-prompt --resume 等类claude命令

description.en: A plugin for Deepseek Harness (well it may support other AI agent IDEs but I hadn't test it out yet) that checks for error when AI had finished writing the code.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 代码全面检查插件：三步流水线（编译运行检查 → 功能完整性核对 → 真实用户模拟测试），自动把问题反馈给 AI 修复，可选用 GUI，并附带适用于 Trae/Qoder 等平台的独立 CLI 与 MCP 服务

description.en: Surveys local code and GitHub/npm for reusable implementations before development, evaluates reuse versus rewrite, and checks architecture coupling.
description.zh: 在开发前检索本地代码与 GitHub/npm 的可复用实现，评估复用与重写成本，并检查架构耦合。

description.en: A workbench for programmers to review code and track changes, featuring a conversation navigation rail for jumping to any earlier turn in the dialogue.该工作台专为程序员打造，旨在高效审阅代码并追踪变更历史。其内置的对话导航轨道可常驻显示，支持用户一键跳转至对话中的任意历史轮次，极大提升代码审查与上下文回溯的效率。

description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用你的 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅，并支持图像生成和 Web 搜索。

description.en: Adds OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT) as a selectable DSH provider via the local Codex App Server.
description.zh: 通过本机 Codex App Server，将 OpenAI Codex（ChatGPT）作为可选 DSH Provider。

description.zh: untranslated

description.en: 把 DeepSeek Harness 做成一个真正的桌面应用：Electron 主进程内嵌 Cordis Host（与官方 Web 版同内核、零移植）， 渲染进程加载官方 Web UI 发行物（file:///自定义协议 + IPC 桥接，不开放 HTTP 端口）， 所有桌面原生能力（托盘、全局热键、系统通知、剪贴板、开机自启、协议唤起、多窗口）以 host 插件 形态注入运行时， 与官方「一切皆插件」的架构同构——不是给网页套壳，而是把桌面能力变成可装配、可卸载、可审查的插件树。  AI 驱动开发声明
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 变成真正的桌面应用，原生支持托盘、热键、通知等系统能力，不套壳、不占端口。

description.en: Plugin compiler with a blueprint registry (scaffold → validate → deploy) exposed as a runtime service, three model tools, and a blueprint-gallery settings page.
description.zh: 插件编译器：以运行时服务提供蓝图注册表（脚手架 → 校验 → 部署），配三个模型工具和一个蓝图画廊设置页。

description.en: Free web search with 10 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/AnySearch free + Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), automatic fallback chain, time-filtered advanced search, platform search (GitHub/Reddit), web page fetching, LRU caching, and a settings UI. No API keys required for basic use.
description.zh: 无需密钥即可用 Bing、DuckDuckGo 等 10 个搜索引擎，自动切换可用后端，支持时间过滤和平台搜索。

description.en: Folds Think and tool-call rows into a floating summary pill with red failure counts, for a cleaner writer-friendly chat view.
description.zh: 把 Think / 工具调用等过程行折叠成右下角摘要浮条，失败步骤红色计数，面向文字工作者的干净对话视图。

description.en: Upload an image as a full-window frosted-glass theme: sidebar/conversation/details share one frost layer, Save/Delete, official Light/Dark/System stay in charge.
description.zh: 上传图片作为整窗磨砂玻璃主题：侧栏/会话/详情同一层磨砂，保存/删除，官方浅色/深色/跟随系统仍有效。

description.en: DSH-Feishu channel plugin

description.zh: DSH Typewriter: WebAudio typing ambience with a plugin-owned settings API and zero audio assets

description.zh: DSH weather tab and weather-following themes powered by Open-Meteo

description.zh: 将多个 DeepSeek Harness 对话融合为一个可继续的会话，支持 Agent 智能剪枝、话题分组、内容排序和界面操作

description.en: Galgame Doctor for DeepSeek Harness: safe translation-memory migration, engine evidence, strict QA, and rollback.

description.zh: 提供 generation_fork 与 generation_run，用于拷贝 Agent preset 并在新会话上跑任务。

description.en: Capability transform & assembly engine (Qian Xuesen cybernetics/systems framework): static resident layer manages the skill/MCP/plugin registries, auto-absorbs skills and tool metrics, and drives a negative-feedback evolution loop (scan Sick/Weak → mutate → select promote/reject → 30s rollback); includes a Web UI panel and a GitHub dsh-plugin store bridge.
description.zh: 能力转化与组装引擎（钱学森工程控制论/系统论框架）：静态常驻层管理 skill/MCP/插件三库、自动吸收技能与工具度量，驱动负反馈进化闭环（scan Sick/Weak → mutate → select 晋升/淘汰 → 30s 回滚）；含 Web UI 面板与 GitHub dsh-plugin 商店桥。

description.en: Dedicated read-only Git Graph view beside Chat and Trajectory: commit topology, local/remote/tag refs, HEAD and working-tree status, search, filtering, first-parent mode, refresh, and load more.

description.en: Git-backed, reviewable long-term context for DeepSeek Harness.
Git and source-control plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness: local git operations plus GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps and Gitea adapters, with self-evolving memory.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 与源码管理插件套件：本地 git 操作，外加 GitHub、GitLab、Bitbucket、Azure DevOps 与 Gitea 适配器，并带自演进记忆。

description.en: VSCode-style uncommitted-changes sidebar docked to the right of the DSH web conversation page: staged / unstaged / untracked file groups, status badges, per-file +/− line counts, click-to-expand diff, rename as old → new, untracked content preview, and open with the system default application.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: Git status pill in the session header — branch, dirty counts, ahead/behind, recent commits & changed files.
Conventional-commit enforcement, changelog generation, PR summaries and branch pushes through the plain git CLI.
description.zh: 规范提交（Conventional Commits）、自动 changelog、PR 描述生成与分支推送，纯 git CLI 实现。

description.en: DSH plugin: connect DSH to GitHub — OAuth device-flow login plus github_* tools (repos, issues, PRs, files, search) and a config-page auth card. / 连接 DSH 与 GitHub 的插件：OAuth 登录认证 + github_* 工具（仓库、issues、PR、文件、搜索）与配置页认证卡片。
Track releases and stars of any public GitHub repository from inside dsh agents — no API key needed.
description.zh: 让 dsh agent 直接查询任意 GitHub 公开仓库的 Release 与星标变化，无需 API Key。

description.en: A global task library plugin for DeepSeek Harness featuring cross-session persistence, a real-time generative-UI browser panel, and subagent job synchronization.DeepSeek Harness 全局任务插件：提供跨会话持久化任务库、生成式 UI (Generative-UI) 悬浮面板及子智能体 (Subagent) 状态自动同步。
description.zh: 全局任务库插件，跨会话保存任务，实时界面管理，并同步子代理任务状态，提升多任务协作效率。

description.en: OpenCode GO 套餐用量监控插件：账户三窗口额度 + DSH 按模型 Token/金额统计，为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 而生
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: OpenCode GO 套餐用量（三窗口额度 + DSH 按模型 token/金额统计 + 输入框迷你条）

description.en: Goal-driven multi-agent orchestration for DeepSeek Harness — bounded DAG scheduling, nested delegation, typed evidence, and durable trajectory UI.
GPU-aware execution layer for DeepSeek Harness: gpu_status / gpu_exec / gpu_run_bg tools, auto card selection, per-step GPU context

DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin bundle: grok-geo GEO brand audit agent skill - AI-search visibility, recommendations, citations, competitor presence and content-gap diagnosis across 17+ AI engines, shipped as a bundled skill provider.

description.en: DSH Web Plugin: 工作区底部开辟一个迷你面板，当AI帮你工作时，不要荒废大脑，来一把掼蛋游戏。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 联盟模式：自由组合 DSH、Claude Code、Codex 与全部已配置模型，保留原生 Agent 生命周期与实时执行过程。

Huawei HarmonyOS assistant-today (负一屏) task-completion push for DeepSeek Harness: hiboard_push / hiboard_verify tools post Markdown task results to the phone card feed, wire-compatible with the OpenClaw today-task skill, with the authCode managed from the dsh settings panel.

description.en: Push task-completion messages to the Huawei HarmonyOS assistant-today (负一屏) card feed from DeepSeek Harness — wire-compatible with the OpenClaw today-task skill.
Recall and re-run the current session's command history with ↑/↓ keys in the DSH Web composer.

description.zh: 在运行中的 DeepSeek Harness 网页上直接热装、热卸、更新、启停插件，无需重启，自带管理界面。

description.en: 不用一直在电脑前，远程操控Deepseek Harness，在飞书 / 企业微信 / Telegram 里指挥 DeepSeek Harness：远程派活 · 结果通知 · 危险操作审批

description.zh: 为 DSH 增加局域网访问开关，无需手动改配置，一键开启/关闭 Web GUI 的局域网访问。

Freshness gate for the agent's test, typecheck, lint and build claims: each verification run becomes a receipt on tools/post-execute, file edits are tracked, and on agent/turn-stopping a claim whose latest receipt is stale, failed or has no readable result steers one more step naming the receipt and the files edited since.
description.zh: 为智能体的测试、类型检查、lint 与构建结论提供新鲜度检查：每次验证运行在 tools/post-execute 上记录为凭据，文件修改被跟踪；在 agent/turn-stopping 时，若结论对应的最新凭据已过期、失败或没有可读结果，则引导再走一步，并指出凭据与其后被修改的文件。

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 生成可复现的多源发布证据，自动下载清单中所有镜像，保障软件供应链安全。

description.en: SSH remote ops for DSH: pair servers over SSH or a one-time-code remote-hostd, then run commands, manage background jobs, and read or write remote files with reviewable changes (host_pair/host_bash/host_jobs/host_read_file/host_write_file/host_review_changes).
description.zh: DSH SSH 远程运维：通过 SSH 或一次性配对码的 remote-hostd 连接服务器，执行命令、管理后台任务、读写远程文件并审阅变更（host_pair/host_bash/host_jobs/host_read_file/host_write_file/host_review_changes）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 远程工作区插件：通过 SSH 连接一台或多台服务器，直接在 DSH 的 Web 界面里浏览文件、编辑代码、执行命令——体验类似 VS Code Remote-SSH，无需离开对话。
description.zh: 通过 SSH 连接远程服务器，在 DSH 网页里直接浏览文件、改代码、跑命令，像用 VS Code Remote-SSH 一样方便，不用离开对话。

description.en: a history navigator for deepseek-harness
Turn a DeepSeek Harness session into deliverable work reports (daily/weekly/handoff/article) with verifiable receipts; cross-session weekly aggregation and Feishu/Notion publishing.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话一键变成日报、周报、交接文档或文章，自带可验证凭证，交付更省心。

description.en: Floating restart button for the DSH web GUI: restarts the dsh process in place with a full-screen overlay and auto-reloads the page; no launcher script required, works on Windows/macOS/Linux.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面右下角的一键重启按钮：全屏遮罩原地重启 dsh 进程并自动刷新页面；无需启动脚本，跨 Windows/macOS/Linux。

description.en: AI can write resume text, but templates may still look wrong, pages may overflow, whitespace may remain, and small edits can destabilize the layout. dsh-resume provides an end-to-end DSH workflow for truthful content refinement, template selection, A4 layout tuning, visual review, and tailored resume versions for different job-search scenarios.
description.zh: AI 写简历容易，但写完常会遇到模板不合适、排版溢出、页面留白过多，以及改一处导致全局变形等问题。dsh-resume 专注解决手动修改简历繁琐、低效的问题，让 DSH 覆盖从内容撰写、模板选择到排版调优的完整简历工作流，并支持针对不同求职场景产出合适的简历版本。

description.en: 让 DeepSeek Harness 自动重试商汤 429/QUOTA 等瞬时网关故障直到任务完成——启动时给所有 llm-pi-ai provider 热注入加固版 retryPolicy。
description.zh: 自动重试商汤等网关的429限流和瞬时故障，任务不再中断，无需手动干预。

description.en: Native interactive Git diff review for DeepSeek Harness with structured annotations sent back to the current Agent session.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生交互式 Git diff 审查，支持结构化批注并回传当前 Agent 会话。

description.en: Fold everything since the last checkpoint mark into an auto-generated report, replacing it in context while keeping the full log.
description.zh: 把上次检查点之后的所有内容折叠成一份自动报告，替换进上下文，同时保留完整日志，帮你理清思路。

description.en: DSH 多方群聊协作插件（圆桌）：把不同人设的 AI Agent 拉进同一研讨房间，互相讨论、交叉补充、质疑修正，最终一键总结出综合方案；也支持把工作区已有的对话框拉进来参与讨论，消除信息隔离。支持手动 @ / 全体研讨 / 接力链三种发言模式，含轮次上限、全局暂停等防死循环控制。官方 bundle 插件：dsh plugin --profile web add github:vuchisu069-source/dsh-round-table#main
description.zh: 把多个不同人设的AI拉进一个房间群聊，互相讨论、补充、质疑，最后自动总结出综合方案，还能拉入现有对话框一起参与。

description.en: Multi-route high-availability, fault isolation and observability for DeepSeek Harness: model groups fail over between authorized provider routes on rate limits, retry-after, transport and auth failures.
description.zh: 多路由高可用插件，当模型供应商限流或故障时自动切换备用线路，保障智能体稳定运行。

description.en: Adds a subagent_routed tool that runs a one-shot subagent fully mounted on any agent preset from any session, with per-call model/provider override and a model-availability pre-check.
description.zh: 新增 subagent_routed 工具：从任意会话发起一次性子 Agent，并完整挂载到任意 agent preset 上运行，支持按次覆盖模型/提供方，并在调用前预检模型可用性。

description.en: TriComposer · DSH web 端 RP 结构化输入插件：台词/动作/心理分框填空、模板组装发送，从输入层消除 AI 对玩家言行的成分误识别。Structured tri-channel input composer for LLM roleplay on DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: RP对话输入增强插件，将台词、动作、心理分框填写，避免AI误读玩家言行，提升角色扮演体验。

description.en: Rules execution engine for dsh: parses AGENTS.md, hard-blocks rule-violating tool calls, text-based B/D rule auditing, /guard command, version-guard for versioned files, and free-zone support (engine skips free-zone sections).
description.zh: dsh 规则执行引擎：解析 AGENTS.md、硬拦违反规则的工具调用、文本纠察与审计、/guard 命令、版本化文件守卫、自由区域支持（引擎跳过自由区内容）。

description.en: Claude Code rules.md-style rule prompts: activate rule markdown files by glob-matching the files an agent reads or edits, with prompt injection and ordering support.
description.zh: 类 Claude Code rules.md 的规则提示词：按智能体读取或编辑文件的 glob 匹配自动激活规则文档，支持提示词注入与排序。

description.en: 为 DSH 默认沙箱增加可配置的「沙箱授权目录」，允许工作区外的受信修改。
description.zh: 给 DSH 沙箱加个白名单目录，让 AI 能安全地往指定外部文件夹写文件，不用关沙箱也不用反复审批。

description.en: Zero-dependency scientific computing tools for DeepSeek Harness: physical-unit conversion, CODATA physical constants, and Runge-Kutta ODE/dynamical-system simulation. No core changes.
description.zh: Zero-dependency scientific computing tools for DeepSeek Harness: physical-unit conversion, CODATA physical constants, and Runge-Kutta ODE/dynamical-system simulation. No core changes.

description.en: dsh plugin for scnet.cn
description.zh: 专为超算网络设计的DSH插件，让你能直接在对话里提交、监控和管理超算集群任务。

description.en: Quick temporary conversation and workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 临时对话工作区自动化管理插件。

description.en: 还在为繁杂的log而苦恼吗？直接拓扑展示，清晰理顺所有，多智能体也不怕。
description.zh: 将繁杂的会话日志直接变成可浏览的3D拓扑图，主从智能体分叉汇回一目了然，日志细节随时回溯。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for the SeismicX earthquake-catalog skill
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin exposing the SeismicX earthquake-catalog skill as typed, model-facing tools

description.en: Shows a floating toolbar above text selected in a conversation, with copy, quote, ask, explain, translate, summarize, and custom prompt actions.
description.zh: 在对话中选中文本时显示浮动工具栏，提供复制、引用、询问、解释、翻译、总结与自定义提问操作。

description.en: Benchmark-driven self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness · 冻结基准上的 Agent Profile 自我进化：评测 → 候选 → 严格接受/回滚
description.zh: Benchmark-driven self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness · 冻结基准上的 Agent Profile 自我进化：评测 → 候选 → 严格接受/回滚

description.en: Turns the user into an RPG protagonist: after each finished user turn a random "adventure" may trigger, drawn from 700+ events across 7 themed pools (sci-fi, fantasy, ancient, anime, novels, wuxia, urban), growing six persistent attributes (strength, intelligence, agility, charisma, luck, vitality) with XP, levels and attribute-weighted story branches, configured via a settings-page UI.
description.zh: 把用户本人当作 RPG 主角：每轮对话结束后有几率触发随机「奇遇」，事件库 700+，覆盖科幻/玄幻/远古/动漫/小说/武侠/都市七大主题，增减力量/智力/敏捷/魅力/幸运/体魄六维属性，积累经验升级并随等级解锁更宏大的事件，含属性加权分支与设置页可视化配置。

description.en: DSH plugin: estimated DeepSeek API cost per session in the web GUI stats strip
description.zh: DSH plugin: estimated DeepSeek API cost per session in the web GUI stats strip

description.en: Session handoff & context management: structured handoff documents (export/resume/status) so a fresh session can continue seamlessly, plus active context pruning (acp_* tools via the official compaction API with model-authored summaries).
description.zh: 会话交接与上下文管理：导出/恢复结构化交接文档，让新会话无缝续接；并集成了主动上下文裁剪（acp_* 工具，基于官方 compaction API 与模型自写摘要）。

description.en: Right-click session menu and sidebar session manager: pin, rename, archive, fork, export, copy cwd/id/deep link, and open in explorer or a new window.
description.zh: 会话行右键菜单与侧边栏会话管理：置顶、重命名、归档、分叉、导出、复制工作目录/会话 ID/深链，在资源管理器或新窗口打开。

description.en: Move a session to another workspace by dragging it onto the target workspace header in the sidebar: the session is cloned with full history into the target workspace and the original is archived.
description.zh: 在侧边栏把会话直接拖到其他工作区的标题行即可移动：目标工作区生成携带完整历史的新会话，原会话归档。

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness plugin — sessions as addressable, first-class citizens: lifecycle controls + cross-session messaging. Companion to deepseek-harness#3640
Persistent pinned-session menu for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: dsh-session-pins — DSH 插件（会话）

description.en: Session repair button in the conversation header: detects & fixes session-log corruption — tool-call id swaps, empty call ids (`message must have tool source`), unknown event types from disabled plugins (marks `ignorable`), torn zstd tails, missing final-frame newlines; ghost-style UI, auto-backup before writes.
description.zh: 在会话头部加修复按钮，一键检测并修复日志损坏，解决加载失败和发不出消息的问题。

description.en: Search, list and read past and current sessions through the harness's own `sessionQuery` service: uses the SQLite FTS5 index where a deployment enables it, and falls back to a bounded newest-first scan where it does not.
description.zh: 通过 harness 自带的 `sessionQuery` 服务搜索、列出、读取历史与当前会话：部署启用了 SQLite FTS5 索引时走索引，未启用时回退到有上限的倒序扫描。

description.en: Sidebar session-search toggle between title and content: title filters by session title, content searches historical messages through DSH's built-in full-text index, grouped per session with the strongest snippet and message-type tags.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话搜索开关，标题 / 内容一键切换：标题按会话标题过滤，内容经 DSH 自带全文索引搜索历史消息关键词，结果按会话聚合，附最强命中片段与消息类型标签。

description.en: Lightweight read-only session lineage navigation for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Git-like immutable session branching for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: A DSH Web plugin that turns chat sessions into editable mind maps, with Markdown, Mermaid, PlantUML, XMind text, and TODO exports.
description.zh: 把聊天会话整理成可编辑的思维导图，过滤调试噪声，支持导出 Markdown、Mermaid 等多种格式。

description.en: Adds a Windows Explorer right-click action to open a folder as a DSH workspace, launching DSH if needed.
description.zh: 给 Windows 文件管理器加右键项：把文件夹设为 DSH 工作区并切换到它，DSH 未运行会自动拉起。

description.en: Advanced form- and file-level settings management with a plugin settings registration SDK.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 设置管理，提供更灵活、更高效的配置选项，让插件设置更顺手。

description.en: 一键结束 DeepSeek Harness 服务：Settings 关机页 + 二次确认 + 优雅退出，关掉浏览器不再留下后台进程
description.zh: 一键关闭或重启 DSH 服务，带二次确认和优雅退出，关掉浏览器不再留后台进程。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 与 Codex、Claude Code、Pi、Reasonix、OpenCode 之间双向迁移对话记录，支持 CLI 与 Web UI
DSH plugin: Codex-style side conversations (/side, /btw), an integrated right workspace (Side/Subagents/Goal) and a ChatGPT-style pinned-notes board
description.zh: 在 DSH 里开侧边对话、记置顶笔记，还能把子任务和目标面板整合到右侧工作区，像 Codex 一样顺手。

description.en: Hand off focused context without waiting for or interrupting the active Agent: freeze a bounded Session snapshot, summarize it asynchronously with an isolated no-tool LLM, and deliver a provenance-bearing capsule to another Session or an authorized Room—quiet by default for Sessions, with explicit wakeup available.
description.zh: 无需等待或打断正在工作的 Agent：即时冻结有界 Session 快照，由隔离且无工具的 LLM 异步总结，再将带来源信息的上下文胶囊投递到另一 Session 或已授权 Room；对 Session 默认 quiet，也可显式 wakeup。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏文件树插件：会话/文件标签栏 + 懒加载文件树，按扩展名彩色图标、复制路径、发送给 Agent。A sidebar file tree plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Sessions/Files tabs, lazy tree, per-extension icons, copy-path and send-to-agent.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏添加文件树，支持会话/文件切换、懒加载、彩色图标，一键复制路径或发送给 Agent。

description.en: 把默认的四种模式切换塞进「新会话」按钮里，新会话创建更方便（标准/PTC/创造/极简，与设置双向同步）
description.zh: 把模式切换塞进新会话按钮，点一下就能选标准/PTC/创造/极简，不用再进设置页，新会话创建更顺手。

description.en: Plug-in vision for text-only DeepSeek Harness (dsh) models: built-in free/cheap VLM presets + multi-image batch analysis
description.zh: Plug-in vision for text-only DeepSeek Harness (dsh) models: built-in free/cheap VLM presets + multi-image batch analysis

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：审查最近改动的代码，就清晰度、一致性与可维护性提出改进（移植自 pi-simplify）
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：审查最近改动的代码，就清晰度、一致性与可维护性提出改进（移植自 pi-simplify）

description.en: 一个温暖、超可爱、派蒙风格萝莉音的「妹妹」陪伴 Agent（DeepSeek Harness 插件）
description.zh: DSH companion plugin: a warm, cheerful 'little sister' agent that speaks with a soft voice in the browser, auto-reads every reply aloud, fires scheduled daily cheers, and lifts the learner's mood with lots of positive emotion.

description.en: Import, validate, manage, and migrate Agent Skills for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), Claude Code, Codex, and other AI coding agents.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里一站式导入、校验和管理各类 AI 编程助手的技能包，轻松迁移无缝复用。

description.en: Per-conversation skill catalog picker for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — choose which skills are loaded into each conversation. Unselected skills are unavailable in that conversation.
description.zh: Per-conversation skill catalog picker for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — choose which skills are loaded into each conversation. Unselected skills are unavailable in that conversation.

description.en: Deepseek Harness 的Skill管理插件
description.zh: Deepseek Harness 的Skill管理插件

description.en: Nightly self-improvement for your DeepSeek Harness agent: harvest past sessions offline, replay recurring tasks on your own API budget, and consolidate validated skills behind a held-out gate. Brings microsoft/SkillOpt's SkillOpt-Sleep engine to dsh as native tools plus a bundled skill - no weight training. Requires Python 3.10+ and the SkillOpt-Sleep engine (pip install skillopt).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness agent 提供夜间自我进化：离线复盘过往会话，在你的 API 预算内重放高频任务，并把学到的技能凝练成经得起门禁验证的技能。把 microsoft/SkillOpt 的 SkillOpt-Sleep 引擎带进 dsh，作为原生工具加内置技能——无需模型训练。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装 SkillOpt-Sleep 引擎(pip install skillopt)。

description.en: Scans the skills visible to the current session and ranks them by relevance to the recent conversation.
description.zh: 扫描当前会话可见的技能，按与最近对话的相关性排序推荐。

description.en: Read-only Skills settings page plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web
description.zh: 在设置面板中新增只读的技能列表页面，方便你快速查看和管理当前会话的技能配置。

description.en: DSH Skills 可视化管理器：在 DSH Web 界面可视化查看、编辑、创建、删除 Skills（用户级 ~/.dsh/skills 与项目级 .dsh/skills）
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页里直接管理你的 Skills，可视化增删改查，不用再敲命令行。

description.en: DSH skin plugin: Alphacoders popular wallpapers as the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI background — gallery, search, local image upload, light/dark mask
description.zh: 把 Alphacoders 热门壁纸设为 DeepSeek Harness 网页背景，支持图库浏览、搜索、本地上传和明暗遮罩，让界面更好看。

description.en: dsh Web UI skin: DeepSeek blue-whale theme with official gradient and leaping whale art (dsh plugin)
description.zh: 「蓝鲸跃海」皮肤：官方渐变 + 跃起的鲸鱼，极简安静。

description.en: Claude Code-inspired skin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上 Claude Code 风格皮肤，界面更清爽、更贴近终端美学。

description.en: A skin toolbox for DeepSeek Harness with 10 built-in wallpapers, live tuning, and image/video DIY skins.
DeepSeek Harness 自定义皮肤工作室，支持全界面配色、组件图片/视频背景与皮肤包分享
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 皮肤工作室 — 内置精选皮肤 + 用户上传皮肤中心

description.en: DSH 换肤插件镜像 + 夕港（harbor）皮肤 | Mirror of dsh-external/dsh-skins + harbor (夕港) dusk-harbor skin
description.zh: dsh-skins — DSH 插件（界面）

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: automatic file snapshots with a sidebar timeline and settings card
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: automatic file snapshots with a sidebar timeline and settings card

description.en: The light palette combines silk-paper surfaces, warm ink text, Ru-celadon interactions, and cinnabar error states. The dark palette uses night-ink surfaces with a brighter celadon accent. Display headings prefer installed Song and CJK serif fonts; body text keeps the Harness sans-serif stack.
description.zh: The light palette combines silk-paper surfaces, warm ink text, Ru-celadon interactions, and cinnabar error states. The dark palette uses night-ink surfaces with a brighter celadon accent. Display headings prefer installed Song and CJK serif fonts; body text keeps the Harness sans-serif stack.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的独立双面插件，用于把产品的原始需求澄清为研发和开发 AI 可直接理解的 Ready Spec。产品、研发、产品 AI 与研发 AI 在同一份 Git 版本化 Markdown 上完成初审、逐项回复、二次审核、候选 patch、产研共审、Decision、分角色确认与 Ready 质量门。
Real-time voice input and spoken answer summaries for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 支持实时语音输入和语音播报回答，解放双手，边说话边编程。

description.en: DSH community plugin: multi-host SSH tunnel + SSHManager (better-sidebar)
description.zh: 多主机 SSH 隧道管理，配合侧边栏插件，轻松连接和切换远程服务器。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness watchdog plugin: detects truly stalled agent turns (never killing in-progress tasks — in-flight operations are exempt), nudges/terminates only on real silence, records every event to JSONL with a loopback status route
description.zh: 任务看门狗：检测真正卡死的回合，用「排查→修复→换方向」阶梯引导恢复，绝不误杀。

description.en: DSH plugin: provider/model usage stats dashboard with response speed, call log, token totals, cache rate, cost estimates, CSV export
description.zh: Provider/模型用量看板：响应速度、调用日志、token 总量、缓存率、成本估算，支持 CSV 导出。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 SillyTavern 角色卡、世界书与预设创作插件，集成 Preset Plus。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 编写 SillyTavern 角色卡、世界书和预设，内置 Preset Plus，让创作更顺手。

description.en: One-click collapse of every expanded section (Think rows, tool cards) with a live-count pill and a customizable hotkey.
description.zh: 一键收起会话中所有展开的区块（Think、工具卡等），常驻计数按钮 + 自定义快捷键。

description.en: Workspace sticky notes for DSH, saved as multiple Markdown files under the current workspace.
description.zh: DSH 工作区极简便签：在各个工作区保存多张 Markdown 便签，记录你的想法和项目进程。

description.en: DSH STORE — third-party plugin marketplace and guarded lifecycle manager for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DSH 官方插件市场，帮你安全发现、安装和管理 DeepSeek Harness 插件，一站式搞定扩展。

description.en: Shared lifecycle admission protocol and reference policy kernel for DeepSeek Harness subagents.
description.zh: 共享生命周期准入协议与参考策略内核（面向子代理）。

description.en: Adds a subagent_codex tool that delegates tasks to the local OpenAI Codex CLI, running the work in an isolated external process.
description.zh: 新增 subagent_codex 工具，把任务委派给本机 OpenAI Codex CLI 在独立外部进程中执行，与主对话完全隔离。
