description.zh: 把内置 'Deep diving...' 思考状态行扩展为 53 条 deep 系英/中双语短语池：回合开场随机一条，随新思考段/工具调用事件轮换（最短间隔 3 秒），点击状态行切换中英文。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek API balance and local DSH Flash and Pro usage costs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中查看 DeepSeek API 余额及本机 Flash 和 Pro 消费统计。

description.en: DeepSeek balance widget for the dsh web sidebar

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里加一个独立的聊天窗口，直接问 DeepSeek，不用切换页面。

description.en: DeepSeek API quota panel collapsed into a left-edge handle for the Web UI: click to expand balance, official today's consumption (with platform token) and live conversation cost; fork of dsh-deepseek-quota.
description.zh: DeepSeek API 额度面板折叠为左侧边框把手：点击展开查看余额、官方精确今日已消费（配置平台 token 后）与实时对话费用；dsh-deepseek-quota 的修改版。

description.en: DSH 侧边栏实时显示 DeepSeek 官方服务状态（status.deepseek.com）| Live DeepSeek official service status in the DSH sidebar
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏实时显示 DeepSeek 官方服务状态，一眼掌握整体及各项服务是否正常。

description.en: DSH 插件：极简的 DeepSeek 余额/用量面板，无任何多余窗口，极简配置
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页直接查看 DeepSeek 余额和用量，轻量无干扰，配置简单。

description.en: Reuses DeepSeek web's built-in vision mode for text-only models: the deepseek_vision tool drives the local deepseek-vision-cli browser automation (manual login helper, deep-think enabled, auto-closes browser) and returns image descriptions as text.
description.zh: 复用 DeepSeek 网页端识图模式给纯文本模型补上看图能力：deepseek_vision 工具调用本地 deepseek-vision-cli 浏览器自动化（手动登录助手、自动开启深度思考、用后自动关窗），把图片描述以文字返回给模型。

description.en: Delayed wake-up for DeepSeek Harness: schedule a reminder and the agent wakes in the SAME conversation to reply — plus an interruptible wait (timed gate) tool. Host-level timer + official agent.followup() wake channel.
Ranked subagent delegation: role-based model routing with failover, per-route reasoning effort, model-transparent labels, fork delegation, and a visual route editor.
description.zh: 智能委派套件：按角色路由最强模型、失败自动互备、每个子代理可设思考强度、名字带模型标签、支持 fork 委派与可视化路由编辑。

description.en: Dependency supply-chain hygiene audit for dsh projects and profiles: peer-range resolvability, broken dist-tag detection (#2763 class), stale / missing-license / non-registry dependencies, and installed-vs-declared drift — CLI plus an agent-callable dep_audit tool.
description.zh: dsh 项目与 profile 的依赖供应链卫生审计：peer 范围可解析性、坏 dist-tag 检测（#2763 类）、过期/缺许可证/非注册表来源依赖与安装版本漂移——CLI + agent 可调用 dep_audit 工具。

description.en: Inspired By Calude design, A Deepseek harness Design Plugin!, Select elements, Use Open Router Vision agents, upload images and much more!! You can make quick changes with deepseek or invoke the Vision model with a prompt directly!
description.zh: 把设计稿变成可交互的网页原型，实时预览、AI 视觉审稿，还能一键打包导出。

description.en: 设计令牌命名规范参考
Ready-to-use desktop distribution of the official DeepSeek Harness for macOS and Windows.
description.zh: 免安装、免命令行的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版，开箱即用，支持 macOS 和 Windows。

description.en: macOS desktop shell for the DSH web UI: a plugin plus a small Tauri/WKWebView window over the loopback web surface — real macOS fullscreen, single instance, external links delegated to the system browser, and browser-style zoom.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web UI 装进原生 macOS 桌面窗口：插件 + 轻量 Tauri/WKWebView 外壳跑在同一个 loopback 地址上——真 macOS 全屏、单实例、外链交给系统浏览器、类浏览器页面缩放。

description.en: DeepSeekHarnessMac精简版
Desktop profile for dsh: native Tauri window over the harness web surface with tray, native notifications, a file-manager panel, and one-click updates.
description.zh: dsh 桌面配置：原生 Tauri 窗口承载 harness Web 界面，支持托盘、原生通知、文件管理器面板与一键更新。

description.en: AI turns repeated dev commands, prompts, and habits into one-click DeepSeek Harness actions.
description.zh: AI turns repeated dev commands, prompts, and habits into one-click DeepSeek Harness actions.

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) floating workspace directory-tree plugin. Install with `dsh plugin add`, drag-drop file paths into chat, lazy-load, and auto-follows workspace switches.

Push vague or rich, user-configurable DSH interaction states to the local Discord client as Rich Presence — real-time, content-free, with a user-editable status list and an optional rich-mode toggle in Settings.
description.zh: 将模糊或丰富的 DSH 交互状态实时推送到本地 Discord 客户端作为 Rich Presence——不携带任何工作区内容，状态消息列表可自由编辑，并可在设置中切换丰富模式。

description.en: DSH plugin discovery browser - browse & search community plugins on GitHub (read-only, no one-click installs)

Official GitHub Discussions radar for DeepSeek Harness: list, filter and search the official boards (Ideas / Q&A / Show Your Plugins! / General / Announcements / Polls) — CLI plus an agent-callable discussions_radar tool, dsh-discussions-radar/v1 reports, zero runtime deps, read-only public API.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 官方 Discussions 雷达：列出、筛选、搜索官方讨论区（Ideas / Q&A / Show Your Plugins! / General / Announcements / Polls）——CLI + agent 可调用 discussions_radar 工具，dsh-discussions-radar/v1 报告，零运行时依赖、只读公开 API。

description.en: Disk-usage audit for dsh data directories: total size, per-directory breakdown, largest files, oversized-file warnings (session logs can hit hundreds of MB) and cleanup suggestions — CLI plus an agent-callable disk_audit tool, dsh-disk-audit/v1 reports, zero runtime deps, read-only.
description.zh: dsh 数据目录磁盘占用审计：总大小、按目录拆分、最大文件、超大文件告警（会话日志可达数百 MB）与清理建议——CLI + agent 可调用 disk_audit 工具，dsh-disk-audit/v1 报告，零运行时依赖、只读。

description.en: Document-code consistency guard: audits version headers / changelog tables / directory trees / module & test counts / cross-doc references for drift, with severity-sorted, read-only fix suggestions.
description.zh: 文档与代码一致性守护：版本号/更新记录表/结构树/模块清单/测试计数/交叉引用漂移审计与修复建议，全程只读。

description.en: Typed, guarded container control: ps/logs/inspect/exec/start/stop and compose up/down with JSON output, project-aware targeting, and approval-gated destructive ops.
description.zh: 类型安全、带护栏的容器控制：ps/logs/inspect/exec/start/stop 与 compose up/down，JSON 输出、项目感知定位、破坏性操作需审批。

description.en: Find what your DeepSeek Harness (dsh) patches silently broke — dead patches, config fields dropped by whole-config replacement, unmaintaine…
description.zh: dsh-doctor — DSH 插件（工具）

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: review Markdown documents in a local browser with annotations, replacements, and deletion suggestions. Supports single files and whole directories.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: review Markdown documents in a local browser with annotations, replacements, and deletion suggestions. Supports single files and whole directories.

description.en: DSH 斗地主插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 里等回复时来一把（PVP → DSH Agent）
基于抖音官方资料的 DeepSeek Harness 自媒体插件：帮你做选题、审脚本、诊断流量、制定周计划，已用于《商道人物志》近 6 万粉丝实战。
description.zh: 基于抖音官方资料的创作助手，帮你做选题、审脚本、诊断流量、制定周计划，已实战验证。

description.en: DSH 下载管理器：右下角实时进度条，断点续传、多任务并发、镜像加速
description.zh: 右下角常驻下载进度面板，实时显示文件名、百分比、速度和剩余时间，多任务一目了然。

description.en: Codex-style drag-and-drop files, folders, ZIP and Office attachments for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把文件、文件夹、Office 文档和 ZIP 直接拖进会话，自动建索引，让模型精准读取指定内容。

description.en: Installs two selectable Agent Presets: a shell-restricted general-purpose agent and a repository-focused coding agent.
description.zh: 安装两个可选 Agent Preset：默认不暴露 Shell 的通用 Agent，以及面向真实代码仓库的 Coding Pro。

description.en: DSH插件，动态AGENTS.md
description.zh: 在聊天输入框上方提供动态AGENTS.md多选控件，按全局或工作区勾选上下文规则，自动注入会话提示。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 内置嘉立创EDA(EasyEDA) WebSocket 网关桥接插件
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控你电脑上正在运行的嘉立创EDA专业版，实现电路设计自动化。

description.en: dsh plugin: configure reasoning-effort levels (wire spellings), route default level and Anthropic token budgets for third-party models from…
description.zh: dsh-effort-config — DSH 插件（模型）

description.en: Route DeepSeek Harness top-level sessions to pluggable loop engines by agent-preset — Claude Code ships as a built-in engine.
description.zh: A pure runtime that routes DeepSeek Harness sessions to pluggable loop engines by agent-preset. Ships no engine; downstream plugins register engines via ctx.engineSwitch.

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory: dual-scope user/project SQLite stores, FTS5 + offline local vector hybrid retrieval, 9 engram_* tools, per-turn automatic capture, a distillation flywheel, provenance audit, and a bilingual Settings memory-library panel.
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆插件，让智能体记住你的偏好和项目约定，越用越懂你。

description.en: All-in-one UI enhancement layer for DeepSeek Harness web: prompt library with quick-insert and management, two-step AI polish, predicted-reply dock with click-to-send, MCP tool management, scheduled automation, smart session titles, adjustable chat width, full-width AI messages without gray background, auto-collapse for long user messages with smooth expand/collapse animations, and scene-specific entrance animations across all plugin surfaces.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 一站式界面增强：提示词库（快选+管理）、两步 AI 润色、预测回复栏（点击直接发送）、MCP 工具管理、定时自动化、智能会话标题、对话宽度可调、AI 回复占满无灰底、超长用户消息自动折叠（带平滑展开/收起动效），以及各面板的场景化入场动效。

description.en: 专门用来实现dsh的增强插件集
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供增强插件集，覆盖编码场景与个人助理，即装即用提升开发效率。

description.en: One plugin, every upgrade DeepSeek Harness lacks out of the box: multi-engine web search, skills & MCP managers, per-profile plugin toggles, session cleanup with hover-delete, one-click restart/shutdown, themes. Single tool surface, no telemetry.
Injects live time, weather, location, battery, and device context into the DSH system prompt, with a bilingual settings page.
description.zh: 将实时的时间、天气、地点、电量和设备信息注入 DSH 系统提示，并提供双语设置页面。

description.en: dsh-ergonomics — DSH plugin (session)
description.zh: DSH 会话人体工学：/new 一键新会话 + 输入历史 ↑↓ 回溯

description.en: Experience validation layer for DSH: zero-token collection of tool-failure/retry/search signals, AI refinement into verified skill books (three-layer verification), looked up at task start. Ships 10 trial skills and benchmark data (complex-task success 100% vs 60% bare).
description.zh: DSH 经验验证固化层：零 token 采集工具失败/重试/搜索信号，加工轮提炼成经三层检验的技能书，任务开局翻书复用。内置 10 本试验经验 + benchmark 数据（复杂任务成功率 100% vs 裸环境 60%）。

description.en: VS Code-style file explorer for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar file tree + multi-tab preview (code/image/PDF/audio/video/zip), search, sort, split view. Install: dsh plugin --profile web add github:ZrSiO4-y/dsh-explorer
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接浏览文件，像 VS Code 一样带侧边栏、多标签预览和分屏，看代码、图片、PDF、音视频甚至压缩包都行。

description.en: Light-weight explorer plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中浏览工作区文件，并用内置 Monaco 编辑器直接查看和编辑代码。

description.en: Wallpaper Engine skin plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI
description.zh: Use local Wallpaper Engine images, videos, and scene textures as the DeepSeek Harness web background

description.en: On-demand vision for text-only DeepSeek models: upload images, and the model calls a view_image tool backed by any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint (Qwen/DashScope by default).
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 模型提供按需视觉：上传图片后，模型通过 view_image 工具调用任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点（默认 Qwen/DashScope）。

description.en: 失败账本：DeepSeek Harness 工具失败自动记录·签名聚类·跨会话持久化 + 失败感知重试拦截，让 Agent 越用越少犯错，含 Web UI 面板
description.zh: 自动记录工具调用失败并聚类分析，跨会话持久化，反复出错时拦截重试，让Agent越用越少犯错。

description.en: Connects a Feishu self-built app over WebSocket, routes each chat to an independent DSH agent session, and streams replies through a Card JSON 2.0 card with plain-text fallback.
description.zh: 接入飞书自建应用，把每个飞书会话映射到独立的 DSH Agent，经卡片 JSON 2.0 流式回复，不可用时回退纯文本。

description.en: Feishu (Lark) IM bridge for DeepSeek Harness via `dsh plugin add`; one DM user to one persistent dsh session, with full debugging docs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 私聊桥接插件，支持 `dsh plugin add` 一键安装，配套完整调试文档。

description.en: The harness lives in Feishu, on a Linux server. Goal cards, live progress, multi-bot. Not a remote for the webpage.
description.zh: 把飞书当唯一操作界面，不用开网页就能直接控制 DeepSeek Harness，聊天即管理。

description.en: Feishu (Lark) private-chat frontend for DeepSeek Harness: drive, monitor, and approve local agents from Feishu, sharing sessions with the Web GUI
description.zh: Feishu (Lark) private-chat frontend for DeepSeek Harness: drive, monitor, and approve local agents from Feishu, sharing sessions with the Web GUI

description.en: Feishu/Lark bot bridge for DeepSeek Harness — control DSH agents remotely from Feishu.
description.zh: 通过飞书/Lark 远程操控 DSH 智能体，随时随地管理任务和状态。

description.en: Feishu/Lark channel that drives DeepSeek Harness agents from chats: streaming rich cards with live thinking and tool steps, per-turn cost metering at DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates, one-tap approval cards, model-gated image intake, and QR onboarding without a public endpoint.
description.zh: 在飞书聊天里驱动 DeepSeek Harness agent：流式富卡片实时展示思考与工具步骤，按 DeepSeek 峰谷牌价计量每轮费用，一键审批、按模型能力透传图片，扫码即用、无需公网。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Feishu gateway plugin: chat with your DSH agent from Feishu (persistent sessions, /new, Markdown replies, proactive push)
description.zh: 在飞书里直接和你的 DSH 智能体聊天，支持持久会话、Markdown 回复和主动消息推送。

description.en: Feishu notifications (session end / input needed).
description.zh: 会话结束时通过飞书机器人发通知卡片，需要输入时也能提醒你，不错过重要节点。

description.en: Raises Node's HTTP headers/body timeouts for the whole DSH process (default 30 min, proxy-aware) so Ollama and LM Studio models that stay silent while thinking or generating a large tool call are not cut off at 5 minutes; replaces the node_modules undici patch.
description.zh: 全局调高 Node 的 HTTP 超时时间，避免慢速本地模型（如 Ollama、LM Studio）因静默超 5 分钟被中断。

description.en: Session-bound file attachments for DeepSeek Harness Web: drag/paste/button intake, content-addressed storage, bounded office/text/archive readers, three-stage delivery receipt. macOS/Windows/Linux.
Local-first file conversion: 26 conversions across images, PDF (with OCR and experimental PDF→DOCX), data, audio/video and office docs; 7 tools, all local, no API keys.
description.zh: 本地文件格式转换工具，支持图片、PDF、音视频和办公文档等26种转换，无需API密钥，离线可用。

description.en: dsh-file-explorer
description.zh: dsh-file-explorer — DSH 插件（工具）

description.en: File directory card in the DeepSeek Harness Web left sidebar: tree browsing with arrow expand, drive-selection page, interactive breadcrumb…
description.zh: 左侧栏文件目录卡：树状浏览 + 快速预览。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: unified file import - byte-level upload store, file-list context injection, read_attachment/place_attachment tools, historical file bubbles
DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI 插件：输入 @ 引用工作区文件，体验类似 Claude Code 的 @file。
description.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI 插件：输入 @ 引用工作区文件，体验类似 Claude Code 的 @file。
在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接预览多种文件内容，无需切换工具，提升查看效率。

description.en: Floating workspace file-preview window for the Web client: lazy file tree, CodeMirror preview and in-window edit with save, Markdown and image preview, Quick Open search, and opening paths clicked in the conversation.
description.zh: Web 客户端悬浮文件预览窗：懒加载文件树、CodeMirror 预览与窗内编辑保存、Markdown 与图片预览、Quick Open 搜索，以及点击会话中的路径直接打开。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web 的本地文件输入插件。在输入框原有的 + 菜单顶部增加 attach，并用分隔线与 Harness 原生命令区分；不会再增加一个单独按钮。Private local file attachments for DeepSeek Harness with native images and bounded document reading.
description.zh: 在输入框的+菜单里直接附加本地文件，支持图片预览和文档解析，不额外占按钮位置。

description.en: DSH Web UI 文件追踪插件：记录并查看模型读取/写入/编辑的文件，带行号内容与终端风逐行 diff(红删绿增蓝改)、hunk 上下文折叠、可拖拽高度。适配 DSH dsh-v0.1.2-alpha.1，纯客户端零核心改动。
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里追踪模型读写过的每个文件，带行号查看内容，还能看红删绿增的逐行 diff，方便你审查 AI 改动了啥。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 工作区文件上传插件：文件/zip 上传、自动解压、拖拽上传、上限可配置、中英双语 | Workspace file upload plugin for DeepSeek Harness: file & zip upload, auto-extract, drag & drop, configurable limits, zh/en UI
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 工作区文件上传插件：文件/zip 上传、自动解压、拖拽上传、上限可配置、中英双语 | Workspace file upload plugin for DeepSeek Harness: file & zip upload, auto-extract, drag & drop, configurable limits, zh/en UI

description.en: dsh web file-experience plugin: drag & drop any file into the composer (intakes it into the session workspace attachments/ folder) plus @file mentions that list workspace files and insert file references。也可以配合 WebDSH（darker2016/WebDSH）多用户服务器使用。
description.zh: 把文件拖进聊天框就能自动存到工作区，还能用@快速引用文件，右侧文件浏览器和标签页查看器让你边聊边改代码和文档。

description.en: Money math toolbox for DeepSeek Harness: loans & amortization, compound growth, rate conversion, NPV/IRR/payback cash-flow analysis, retirement withdrawal planning — zero runtime dependencies
description.zh: 金融计算工具箱，帮你算贷款、复利、收益率和退休规划，零依赖即插即用。

description.en: Read-only market data for DeepSeek Harness. Ask about a stock, and let DSH call the data tools directly. | 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读金融市场数据。让 DSH 直接调用工具查询行情。
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接查股票行情和金融数据，只读安全，问一句就能拿到市场信息。

description.en: Scheduled bilingual financial reports for DSH: market quotes, news and macro calendar, with per-target timezones and delivery through eight dsh-im channels.
description.zh: DSH 定时双语财经日报：包含行情、新闻与宏观日历，支持每个目标独立配置时区，并通过 dsh-im 的八种通道投递。

description.en: Leaderless flat agent teams for DeepSeek Harness: cross-window structured task dispatch, recorder service, and web dashboard
description.zh: 让多个独立Agent窗口组成无队长扁平团队，跨窗口互派任务，内置记录员实时汇报进展。

description.en: Read-only agent-fleet credential hygiene audit: credential-file permissions, embedded credentials in git remotes (masked in output), and provider token literal counts; zero-dependency and deterministic.
description.zh: 只读的 agent 机群凭据卫生审计：检查凭据文件权限、git remote 内嵌凭据（输出脱敏）与 provider token 字面量计数；零依赖、确定性。

description.en: Electron desktop launcher for DeepSeek Harness, bundling a pinned DSH runtime and curated plugins for Windows and macOS.

description.zh: 在设置里直接换界面和代码字体，实时生效，不用改配置文件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness integration plugin for Neo-MoFox
description.zh: 让 Neo-MoFox 直接调用和管理本机 DeepSeek Harness，无缝集成 AI 能力。

description.en: Skill self-forging plugin for DeepSeek Harness — watch session traces, detect repeated successful tasks, forge them into reusable skills
Git-style conversation fork graph in the session header: colored lanes and fork curves show which session branched from which, with click-to-jump navigation.
description.zh: 会话标题栏内联的 Git 风格 fork 血缘图：用彩色轨道与分叉曲线显示会话从何处分支，并可点击跳转。

description.en: DSH /fresh command: summarize conversation, start new session, archive old one
description.zh: DSH /fresh 命令：一键总结当前对话 → 开启新对话 → 归档老对话（缓解超大会话内存/卡顿，DeepSeek Harness / DSH）

description.en: 人格化伴侣插件 for DeepSeek Harness：角色卡、语音、Live2D、本地记忆与工作陪伴。
description.zh: 人格化伴侣插件 for DeepSeek Harness：角色卡、语音、Live2D、本地记忆与工作陪伴。

description.en: Evidence-first frontier AI radar and reproducibility gate for DeepSeek Harness
替换 DSH 任务运行中的 Deep diving... 状态文案：30 秒随机轮换幽默文案，设置-插件-插件配置页可增删改（最多 50 条），与其他同类插件共存时优先级最高。
description.zh: 把 DSH 任务运行中的“Deep diving...”状态换成随机幽默文案，每 30 秒换一条，还能自己增删改，让等待不再无聊。

description.en: Fuse v1.0: page-level UI generation for DeepSeek Harness - design tokens (theme.json) + code standards (code-style.json), dsh-fuse fence rendering with a pixel-level style inspector (getComputedStyle), undo history, and a three-tab settings panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的页面级 UI 生成插件：设计令牌（theme.json）+ 代码规范（code-style.json），dsh-fuse 围栏页面渲染，带像素级走查器（getComputedStyle）、撤销历史与三 tab 设置面板。

description.en: Use your phone as a DSH peripheral remote: send messages (typed or dictated with the phone keyboard), answer yes/no and choice prompts, browse messages and switch sessions on a Game Boy-style screen, paired over LAN QR or a built-in Cloudflare tunnel.
description.zh: 把手机变成 DSH 的外设遥控台：发送消息（打字或用手机输入法语音转文字）、应答 yes/no 审批与选择题、浏览消息与切换会话，Game Boy 风格屏幕；局域网扫码或内置 Cloudflare 隧道连接。

description.en: Keeps what the agent builds at runtime: turns a `cordis_define` dynamic package into a real installed plugin that survives restart, writing the bundle and registering the profile layer with no pnpm, no network, and no build authorization.
description.zh: 把 agent 现场造出来的插件留下来：将 `cordis_define` 的动态包固化成能跨重启存活的正式插件，写包并注册 profile 层的全过程不用 pnpm、不联网、不需要构建授权。

description.en: Geodesic math toolbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): great-circle distance, bearings, destination points, DMS parsing, rhumb lines, path intersections, spherical polygon areas — zero runtime dependencies
description.zh: 地理计算工具箱，提供球面距离、方位角、目标点、DMS解析等 geodesy 数学函数，零依赖即插即用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: GitLab and GitHub API tokens stay out of the model context — encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM), tools on demand, web settings panel.
description.zh: 帮你安全保管 Git 平台密钥，按需自动注入工具调用，数据全程加密且不进大模型上下文。

description.en: Four dependency-free local git tools (status, diff, log, commit) for DeepSeek Harness operating on the session workspace.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供四个零依赖本地 git 工具（status、diff、log、commit），作用于会话工作区。

description.en: GitHub account management plus a local Git workflow for the web GUI with clone, fast-forward pull, status, commit, push, and host-side push guards.
description.zh: Web GUI 的 GitHub 账号与本地 Git 工作流插件，支持 clone、快进 pull、status、commit、push，推送默认关闭并有宿主侧开关保护。

description.en: DSH-GitHub bridge: direct GitHub access for DSH via the official GitHub MCP server, plus a fix for the official bridge's dropped file content.
description.zh: DSH-GitHub bridge: direct GitHub access for DSH via the official GitHub MCP server, plus a fix for the official bridge's dropped file content.

description.en: One-step GitHub uploader: initializes git, auto-creates or improves README, sets repository topics, and pushes a local project to GitHub.
description.zh: 一键上传项目到 GitHub：自动初始化 git、生成或完善 README、设置仓库 topics，并推送本地项目。

description.en: A github reviewer based on the Deepseek Harness

Read-only GitHub access for agents, wrapping several tools. Inside the tool it automatically probes and selects whichever GitHub access method works locally, and tries network proxies on its own. That cuts down the network and parsing problems an agent may hit when accessing GitHub, and the overhead of it repeatedly trying different approaches.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 项目直接读取 GitHub 上的 PR、Issue 和文件，无需额外配置。

description.en: 在dsh中接入智谱 GLM 视觉模型，让 DeepSeek 等文本模型通过 glm_vision 工具看图。
目标驱动的每日任务计划器：多目标任务数据 + Web 每日预览面板，与微信提醒推送共享数据 · Goal-driven daily task planner for DSH: multi-goal tasks + daily preview panel, one data file with the WeChat reminder pipeline.
description.zh: 目标驱动的每日任务计划器，帮你把多目标拆解成每日任务，还能在网页上预览，并和微信提醒联动。

description.en: Automatic cross-session GoodMemory recall and writeback for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 自动记住跨会话的对话内容，随时回忆并写入，提升连续对话体验。

description.en: openai models for login by chatgpt
Native Graphify knowledge graph plugin providing 10 code intelligence tools, topological search, god nodes discovery, and PR blast radius triage.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 Graphify 知识图谱支持，包含 10 个代码智能工具、拓扑搜索、核心节点发现与 PR 影响分析。

description.en: 掼蛋 Guandan card game plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) - 掼蛋-中联储卫 / GUANDAN-中联储卫
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接玩掼蛋，支持 4 人两副牌完整规则，随时来一局。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness task-protection plugin: preflight scanner (catches missing inject declarations that crash the host), loop detection, recur…
description.zh: 任务防护：预检扫描（抓缺失 inject 声明）、循环检测、防递归崩溃。

description.en: Independent model-backed automatic approval plugin for DSH (Codex Guardian-style auto-review)
Guardian preset for DeepSeek Harness with independent persistent Codex auditing
String-matches tool-call input arguments, blocks dangerous tool calls (deny) or allows them with an injected warning (warn), and ships a full rules-management panel.
description.zh: 对 agent 工具调用输入参数做字符串匹配，命中危险行为则拦截（deny）或放行但注入警告（warn），附规则管理面板。

description.en: Vets local, npm, and GitHub plugin source before installation, blocks configured high-risk tool calls at runtime, audits output secret patterns, and writes HMAC-chained local audit logs.
description.zh: 在安装前体检本地、npm 与 GitHub 插件源码，运行时拦截命中配置阈值的高风险工具调用，审计输出中的密钥模式，并写入 HMAC 链式本地审计日志。

description.en: dsh-gzip插件：压缩API响应，降低带宽占用，解决低速网络下历史加载失败问题
description.zh: 压缩API响应数据，减少带宽占用，让低速网络下历史记录也能快速加载。

description.en: Habits editor for DeepSeek Harness — edit the user-global AGENTS.md from Web settings, injected into every session
description.zh: 习惯编辑器：从 Web 设置页编辑用户全局 AGENTS.md。

description.en: DSH 插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 会话之间保存 / 加载开发交接文档（/handoff save | load，含确定性脱敏与 Git 状态捕获）
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话间保存和加载开发交接文档，自动脱敏并记录 Git 状态，换会话不丢上下文。
把会话上下文打包成交接条，串成时间线，换班或切换任务时人和AI都能快速翻看，不丢上下文。

description.en: AI-driven source-code security scanning workbench: 5 model tools (start/finding/status/report/list) plus a /hawkeye web UI and JSON/Markdown/HTML vulnerability reports; zero-dependency Cordis plugin, installable as agent preset or npm package.
description.zh: AI 驱动的源代码安全扫描工作台：5 个模型工具（start/finding/status/report/list）、/hawkeye Web UI 和 JSON/Markdown/HTML 漏洞报告；零依赖 Cordis 插件，可作 agent preset 或 npm 包安装。

description.en: Read-only DSH environment health check: disk, memory, latency, ~/.dsh bloat and outdated-plugin detection with graded reports and baseline trend comparison. Deletes nothing.
description.zh: DSH 环境只读体检：磁盘/内存/延迟/缓存膨胀/插件版本落后检测，分级报告并对比历史基线趋势。只读，不删任何东西。

description.en: damozhang/dsh-herdr-bridge 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的网页会话桥接到 Herdr，让智能体之间能互相发现、启动、对话和观察。

description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness agents: automatic recall each turn, a retain/recall/reflect tool, standing rules, and visibility you scope to the whole bank, a preset, or a session.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 智能体装上长期记忆，每轮自动回忆，还能手动保留、召回和反思，让对话不中断。

description.en: Local-memory lifecycle for the official Hindsight plugin on DSH desktop: one-click start/stop of the hindsight-embed daemon, auto-start on boot, stop on exit, hides the uv.exe console window, and installs the vault/models to another drive.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端官方 Hindsight 插件补齐本地记忆生命周期：一键启停 hindsight-embed 守护进程、开机自启、退出随停、隐藏 uv.exe 黑框，并支持把档案柜与模型装到其它盘。

description.en: 将codex和claude项目历史同步到dsh
为 DeepSeek Harness 提供桃濑日和的动态插件
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上暖色温柔界面，还有会回应你的桃濑日和虚拟伴侣，让任务过程更治愈。

description.en: dsh 宿主插件——经 webserver 钩子向页面注入旧内核浏览器 polyfill。
description.zh: 通过 webserver 钩子给旧内核浏览器页面注入 polyfill，提升网页兼容性。

description.en: Runtime plugin loading for the Web UI: a watched hot directory installs/updates client-plugin bundles live on every open page, no restart. Includes a right-column subagent dashboard example.
description.zh: Web UI 运行时插件加载：监视热目录，运行中安装/更新客户端插件 bundle，所有页面即时生效，免重启。附子智能体看板示例。

description.en: Plugin install, rollback, and audit as a service for DSH.
description.zh: Plugin install, rollback, and audit as a service for DSH.

description.en: Anchors an approve/answer bubble to each DSH Web sidebar session row — one-click handling of authorization, questions, plan reviews and blocked goals without opening the conversation.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏锚定气泡：会话待授权、提问、计划确认、目标阻断时在会话行旁自动弹出并一键处理，无需点进会话。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns AI-generated HTML into a click-to-edit canvas beside the chat
description.zh: 把 AI 生成的 HTML 变成可点击编辑的画布。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: built-in HTTPS reverse proxy with configurable settings (设置→插件配置→Https Fix)
description.zh: 给 dsh 网页界面套上 HTTPS 反代，配置管理更省心，访问更安全。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 增加古法编程模式，让模型监督你写代码！
description.zh: 让 AI 收起手，只出题和验收，你来写代码，找回古法编程的乐趣！

description.en: Human-in-the-loop tools (`human_task` / `human_task_ready_check`): pause the agent until the user performs a real-world action or returns an observation (GUI operation, game testing, visual verification, hardware checks), gated by session consent and an AFK presence check, returning a structured JSON result via a web task dialog.
description.zh: 人工协作工具（`human_task` / `human_task_ready_check`）：让 Agent 暂停等待用户完成现实操作或返回观察结果（GUI 操作、游戏测试、视觉验证、硬件检查等），内置会话同意与 AFK 在场两级门控，通过 Web 任务窗返回结构化 JSON 结果。

description.en: Three-layer local memory for DeepSeek Harness: L1 frozen-snapshot memory (MEMORY.md/USER.md injected into the system prompt, prefix-cache friendly) + L2 searchable knowledge base (facts + SQLite FTS5, Chinese search via sliding-window tokenization) + L3 import from Hermes/Claude Code/Codex/WorkBuddy with dedup. Auto-injects relevant facts on the first step or memory trigger words (agent/pre-step) and after skill loads (tools/post-execute); data stays on the local drive.
description.zh: DSH 本地混合记忆插件：L1 冻结快照（MEMORY.md/USER.md 注入 system prompt，保 prefix cache）+ L2 可检索知识库（facts + SQLite FTS5，滑窗分词支持中文检索）+ L3 从 Hermes/Claude Code/Codex/WorkBuddy 导入（账本去重）；会话首步或记忆触发词自动注入相关事实，skill 加载后自动召回；数据全部留在本地。

description.en: Text-to-image and image-to-image generation inside DSH through OpenAI-compatible endpoints, with an agent tool, multi-provider fallback, and a side-panel workspace with history.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内直接文生图/图生图：对接 OpenAI 兼容图像接口，提供 Agent 生图工具、多供应商自动降级，以及带生成历史的侧栏工作台。

description.en: Multi-engine reverse image search aggregator: Google Lens, Baidu, Yandex, TinEye, SauceNAO, IQDB, Ascii2d.
description.zh: 多引擎反向识图聚合：Google Lens、百度、Yandex、TinEye、SauceNAO、IQDB、Ascii2d。

description.en: Warp-inspired image-to-theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness: upload a background, extract a palette, and apply a glass UI.
description.zh: 上传或拖入一张图片，自动提取主色调并生成 Warp 风格的毛玻璃主题，让界面随壁纸换肤。

description.en: Chat image-attachment bridge with a `view_image` tool for any OpenAI-compatible VLM (local Ollama or cloud): pasted/dropped images become `view_image` path markers before reaching text-only DeepSeek models.
description.zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的聊天识图插件：view_image 工具转发任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM（本地 Ollama 或云端），对话框粘贴/拖拽的图片自动改写为 view_image 路径标记供模型查看。

description.en: 把 chat.deepseek.com 网页版改造成 dsh（DeepSeek Harness）形态的 Chrome MV3 浏览器扩展 — 复用网页版免费额度，零本地安装
Import MCP servers & Skills from Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / cc-switch into DeepSeek Harness (Settings → General → 导入智能体设置)
Runtime observability and relationship graph for DeepSeek Harness and Cordis
description.zh: 只读查看 DeepSeek Harness 运行时状态，用关系图谱和请求追踪帮你看清插件与 Session 到底在干什么。

description.en: IP & subnet math toolbox for DeepSeek Harness: IPv4 subnet layouts, CIDR summarization, IPv6 subnet math (128-bit exact) and IPv4/IPv6 parsing with RFC 5952 normalization and IANA classification — zero dependencies
description.zh: 纯计算 IP 与子网工具，支持 IPv4/IPv6 解析、CIDR 汇总和子网规划，零依赖离线可用。
为 DeepSeek Harness 提供开发工具包，方便开发者快速构建和调试智能体插件。
让 AI 助手直接通过 J-Link 调试真实硬件，提供可视化面板和 23 个调试工具，帮开发者高效完成嵌入式调试。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness job hunting plugin and runtime skill for local job intelligence workflows.
description.zh: 本地优先的求职插件，帮你整理招聘岗位、确认求职画像、维护意向岗位，让求职流程更高效。

description.en: Economics-first journal/working-paper monitor for DeepSeek Harness: NBER RSS + arXiv econ (4 categories) + Chinese econ journals (Shi Jie Jing Ji via Magtech, Zhong Guo Nong Cun Guan Cha, Cai Mao Jing Ji, Zhong Guo Ren Kou Ke Xue, Jing Ji Guan Li via ajcass) fetch, keyword filter, dry-run/Webhook push, dedup persistence, and schedule_create-compatible briefing.
description.zh: 经济学优先的期刊/工作论文监控插件：NBER RSS + arXiv 经济学（4 类目）+ 中文经管期刊（世界经济-玛格泰克平台，中国农村观察/财贸经济/中国人口科学/经济管理-ajcass 平台）抓取、关键词过滤、dry-run/Webhook 推送、去重持久化、定时简报（schedule_create 兼容）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for generating synchronized K12 English PPTX and DOCX lesson materials
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin for generating synchronized K12 English PPTX and DOCX lesson materials

description.en: Load testing with Grafana k6: smoke-test first, then run scripts and read percentiles from the JSON summary.
description.zh: Grafana k6 压测：先冒烟再跑脚本，从 JSON 汇总读百分位数。

description.en: Local knowledge base manager for DSH agents: multi-format import, CJK-aware chunking, sqlite-vec vector + BM25 hybrid search with bge-reranker-base rerank, snapshots, kbpack export/import and cross-KB search — 22 agent tools plus a Web panel.
description.zh: 本地知识库管理：多格式导入、CJK 感知分块、sqlite-vec 向量 + BM25 混合检索与 bge-reranker-base 重排序、快照恢复、kbpack 导入导出与跨库检索，提供 22 个 agent 工具与 Web 面板。

description.en: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: zero-dependency SQLite FTS5 index for markdown/text/code/web pages, source-cited retrieval, session experience library, interactive kbquery Web panel + knowledge galaxy.
description.zh: 本地知识库插件，自动检索文档并标注来源，还能沉淀会话经验、剪藏网页，让模型回答更靠谱。

description.en: DSH Cordis plugin: turn any source text into an AI knowledge graph (facts/inferences/concepts/definitions/examples/counter-examples/rules) with two-way linking between the graph and the original text.
description.zh: DSH Cordis plugin: turn arbitrary source text into an AI-generated knowledge graph (facts / inferences / concepts / definitions / examples / counter-examples / rules) with two-way linking between the graph and the original text, plus evidence-grounded verification, questioning, one-click fixes and an audit log.

description.en: 菲奖得主强推的百合新闻订阅DSH插件
description.zh: 输入番名，AI 帮你搜遍动画漫画同人，一键提炼头条资讯，还能在会话里直接调用。

description.en: 浮游主题（Krill）——深海世界 + 浅海世界 双模式主题插件（DSH Web）：深色=深海（亮度编码信息层级），亮色=浅海（清澈度编码）；浮游生物动画背景、深潜工作态增强、水母参数入口。dsh-plugin
Fix the DeepSeek Harness web UI on phones: injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill so it works over plain HTTP on your LAN - no certs, no proxy. dsh plugin + CLI, zero dependencies.
DSH 插件：把 dsh 的回环 Web UI 通过 0.0.0.0 反代暴露到局域网，开关/状态/日志嵌入设置页。官方 bundle 插件，安装：dsh plugin --profile web add github:liveqte/dsh-lan-proxy#main
description.zh: 把 dsh 的本地 Web 界面一键暴露到局域网，手机平板都能访问，开关状态直接集成在设置页里。

description.en: Share the DSH workspace over the local network: phones, tablets and other computers browse, download and upload files via browser with no DSH login. Token gate, path boundary, read-only mode and rate limit. Zero-dependency (node:http).
description.zh: 通过浏览器把 DSH 工作区分享到局域网：手机、平板、其它电脑可浏览、下载、上传文件，无需 DSH 登录。带令牌门卫、路径边界、只读模式与速率限制，零依赖(node:http)。

description.en: DSH large-session performance plugin: zero-copy fork + projection warmup + chunked materialize
description.zh: DSH 大会话性能插件：零拷贝 fork + fast initFor + 投影分片预热 + fork 缓存回填 + 分片 materialize + 冷会话 LRU 裁剪 + heap 检测（DeepSeek Harness / DSH）

description.en: Detached-broker supervision of long-running services (dev servers, watchers, mock APIs) that survive turns, sessions and DSH restarts, with a Service sidebar tab (registered via better-sidebar's extension API) and service_start/stop/restart/list/logs model tools.
description.zh: 让长驻服务跨会话持续运行，对话结束也不中断，省去反复启动的麻烦。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 分层长期记忆插件：瞬时/情景/语义三层记忆，自动捕获、AI 提炼、跨会话召回与可视化管理。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加分层长期记忆，自动捕获、提炼并跨会话召回，让 AI 记住你的每次对话。

description.en: dsh-plugin: OMP-style ingress shaping plus optional local /fast-compact for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在工具结果送达模型前进行压缩整形，并支持本地快速压缩，提升 DeepSeek Harness 处理效率。

description.en: DSH Web UI 输入框皮肤:跟随主题的「灯光剧场」边框巡游 + 双光束动画,零依赖纯 CSS,一键开关可调参。

description.en: Add six languages (繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Français, Deutsch, Español) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI language options, with hand-polished per-language translations and automatic fallbacks (Simplified-to-Traditional conversion for zh-TW, English for the others) covering upstream updates and third-party plugins.
description.zh: 為 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 語言選單新增六種語言（繁體中文、日本語、한국어、Français、Deutsch、Español）：各語言逐條精譯，缺字串自動兜底（繁中即時簡轉繁、其他語言回退英文），官方更新與第三方插件都能覆蓋。

description.en: Multi-workspace sandbox: grants file-write access to every registered workspace automatically — add a workspace, write to it immediately, no config or escalation needed.
description.zh: 多工作区沙箱：自动赋予所有已注册工作区的文件写入权限——添加工作区后即可直接写入，无需配置或提权。

description.en: Music theory math toolbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): note parsing, frequency/MIDI conversion, correctly spelled chords (26 qualities) and scales (17 types) — zero runtime dependencies
description.zh: 音乐理论数学工具箱，帮你解析音名、转换频率与MIDI，生成正确的和弦与音阶，零依赖即插即用。

description.en: Network diagnostics toolbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): DNS lookup (10 record types), ICMP ping, TCP port check, TLS cert check, traceroute, WHOIS lookup, public IP — seven read-only probes, zero runtime dependencies
description.zh: 网络诊断工具箱，提供DNS查询、Ping、端口检测、TLS证书检查、路由追踪、WHOIS和公网IP查询，纯只读操作，零依赖。

description.en: He can change your DeepSeek Harness (DSH) page, but it will conflict with dsh-web-ui.
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上科技蓝液态玻璃新皮肤，自动拦截冲突插件，界面颜值与流畅度大幅提升。

description.en: Off-peak task queue plugin for DeepSeek Harness — queue at peak price, drain at night, read the savings report
description.zh: 把耗时任务留到夜间低价时段运行，帮你省下Token费用，早上直接看省钱报告。

description.en: No-setup mode for the DSH web UI: hides advanced surfaces, auto-applies best defaults (chat mode, full access, account balance), and one-click role-play personas (maid/butler).
description.zh: DSH 网页免设置模式：隐藏复杂界面、自动套用最佳设置（聊天模式、Full Access、账户余额），并提供一键人设角色扮演（女僕/管家）。

description.en: dsh memory: Nocturne Memory client for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给DeepSeek Harness装上长期记忆，自动沉淀对话上下文，让AI跨会话也能记住关键信息。

description.en: Cross-platform browser audio alerts that play bundled Chinese prompts when DSH needs user input or finishes a task.
description.zh: 让 AI 安静干活，你专注生活；任务完成或等待时用声音提醒你，不用一直盯着屏幕。

description.en: System-native notifications when a task finishes or needs your confirmation: Windows toast, macOS osascript, and Linux notify-send.
description.zh: 任务完成或需要确认/输入时发送操作系统原生通知：Windows toast、macOS osascript、Linux notify-send。

description.en: DSH 插件：任务结束 / 需要用户决策时弹窗提醒（web toast + 桌面通知），类似 Codex / Claude Code 体验
description.zh: 任务结束或需要你决策时，自动弹窗提醒，让你不错过关键节点，体验更流畅。

description.en: Task-completion notifications via ServerChan / DingTalk / Feishu / generic webhooks.
description.zh: 任务完成通知：ServerChan / 钉钉 / 飞书 / 通用 Webhook。

description.zh: Bark 推送通知到 iPhone：回合完成、等待回答、等待授权等事件由 Host 端发送。

description.en: Semantic notification sounds for DeepSeek Harness: complete/approval/question/block/error via BEL or WAV, with Web UI bell toggle ｜ DeepSeek Harness 语义化通知声音：完成/审批/提问/受阻/错误，经 BEL 或 WAV 播放，带 Web 铃铛开关

description.en: Use ChatGPT (Codex) and Gemini Code Assist subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers — OAuth login in the web UI, no API keys

description.en: dsh-okf-memory: 会话记忆 → OKF 知识沉淀插件(神经自我学习驱动)。Session-to-OKF memory plugin: predictive recall, uncertainty-driven capture, reinforcement feedback, consolidation & forgetting.
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 原生全功能终端交互界面 · Claude Code-styled Terminal TUI & CLI for DeepSeek Harness

将 Claude Code、Codex、Pi 与 dsh 内置循环并排运行，方便对比不同 AI 助手的表现。

description.en: dsh web-UI plugin: open the current session's workspace folder with an installed app (Finder, Terminal, VS Code, Ghostty, Zed, ...) — icons included

description.en: Manages OpenCode Zen free-tier and Go-tier models in settings.yaml — fetches the live model listings from opencode.ai, reports configured-versus-live drift per route, and adds or removes entries through four agent tools and an OpenCode Models settings section.
description.zh: 在 settings.yaml 中管理 OpenCode Zen 免费档与 Go 档模型——实时拉取 opencode.ai 的最新模型列表，按路由对比已配置与线上差异，通过四个 agent 工具和设置页分区增删模型条目。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: one-click OpenCode Go model sync in the settings panel - fetch all server models, probe availability & vision, write back to llm-pi-ai config
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页一键同步 OpenCode Go 的全部模型，自动实测可用性和视觉能力，并写回 llm-pi-ai 配置。

description.en: Bring OpenCode Zen's free models to DeepSeek Harness — zero config, no API key, catalog discovered live from upstream
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 的免费模型一键接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需配置和 API 密钥，即插即用。

Provides a low-resolution preview to understand the page layout, and renders a specified region at high resolution. Packaged as multiple tools for agents.

description.en: Claude Code-style permission rules engine: hard/deny/ask/allow tiers with a hard tier above full access, workspace-scoped rules, wildcard path protection, and a visual staged editor; rules persist in settings.yaml.

description.en: ⚡ DeepSeek Harness 自定义模型增强插件：在配置第三方提供商时，自动从权威模型库补齐上下文大小、Token 上限、视觉多模态输入与思考强度档位。

description.zh: 手机浏览器远程控制 dsh web：插件在设置页新增「远程控制」面板（云端/自建模式切换、账号登录、bridge 启停、反馈），并提供同源 /dsh-remote 路由代理 relay；仓库自带的电脑端 bridge 与自托管 relay-router 构成隧道，把本地 dsh web 以可安装 PWA 形式开放到手机：访问密钥认证、实时设备列表、可选流量配额。

Digital arcade HUD skin: neon cyan/violet/magenta palette, Fusion Pixel fonts, animated sprites (city backdrop, data core, mascot), custom crosshair cursor; light and dark themes follow the system.

description.en: Anime skin pack for the DSH Web UI: five AI-generated HD themes (Ninja, Sakura, Bamboo, Ronin, Ryujin) with per-theme accent palettes, a top-right shirt-icon switcher, and an adjustable transparency slider.
description.zh: 动漫皮肤包：忍者、樱花、竹林、落日、苍龙五套 AI 生成高清主题，各配专属点缀色，右上角衣服图标一键切换，透明度可调。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 换肤插件：10 套预设皮肤 + 自然语言换肤 + 自定义背景图片 + 界面控件联动，设置→通用→「皮肤」行内切换，settings.yaml 跨设备同步。

dsh-skin 增强版：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供皮肤切换与自定义背景壁纸。在原版基础上修复了两处问题——① 大图/特殊格式上传无响应（改用 createImageBitmap 直接解码、增加处理中与错误提示）；② 主题切换时 overrideTokens 触发 theme/change 导致无限递归栈溢出（加皮肤/明暗守卫断开循环）。壁纸存储从 localStorage 压缩方案改为 IndexedDB 原文件直存，全画质显示、零压缩，并自动迁移旧数据。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 换肤换壁纸，修复大图上传卡死和主题切换崩溃，让界面更顺手。

description.en: Sky: Children of the Light skin for the dsh web UI - light children on a glowing star map, candlelight gold and starry night.
description.zh: 光遇·遇境主题皮肤：星盘之上的光之子，烛火暖金与深蓝星空双主题，为 dsh WebUI 定制。

description.en: Sky: Children of the Light themed skin for DeepSeek Harness web UI - light children on a glowing star map, candlelight gold and starry night. 光遇·遇境主题皮肤。

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里像 Codex 一样快速浏览、定位和切换对话，多任务多会话场景下效率拉满。

description.en: A better approach to editing files in DSH.
Minimal snippet and command toolbox for DSH: five tools over a single human-editable JSONL file, zero UI, zero database, zero network, explicit save-only memory.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件集：访问门禁（登录 + HTTPS 反代）、默认值、手机端适配、桌宠、任务套件（看板 / 统计 / Git 图谱 / 皮肤）。Linux 服务器部署 DSH，浏览器 / 手机 / 局域网公网随时调用。
description.zh: 把 DSH 部署到 Linux 服务器，浏览器、手机、局域网随时访问，还带登录门禁、桌宠和任务看板。

description.en: Reasonix-style sound effects for DeepSeek Harness: generative pentatonic ambient music while the agent works, E6-G6-C7 success chime, A6-E6…
description.zh: dsh-sound-effects-plugin — DSH 插件（编排）

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web UI soundscape: turn-complete celebration (synth chime + confetti), blocked/approval alerts, error buzz, typing ambienc…
description.zh: 会话音效：回合完成播放合成铃声 + 环境音。

description.en: 一个 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件，把模糊的编程需求锻造成可执行规格，并在每次任务完成后沉淀为会自动复用的个人提示词模板库。
description.zh: 把模糊需求问清楚再动手，做完自动沉淀成可复用的提示词模板，下次同类任务直接套用。

description.en: 让分布在不同设备与网络中的个人 Agent，在各自的工作区与权限边界内组成可持久委派的团队。 DSH-native delegation for personal Agents across devices and networks, without giving up local workspaces, credentials, or control.
SSH sessions, SFTP, terminals, proxies and port forwarding for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 工作区里直接管理 SSH 会话、SFTP 文件传输、终端、代理和端口转发，远程操作更顺手。

description.en: SSQ (China Welfare Lottery Double Color Ball) helper for DeepSeek Harness: 1000-draw trend tracking, six prediction models with ensemble voting, structure analysis and dan-tuo/random generation via the ssq tool.
description.zh: 双色球助手 DSH 插件：千期趋势追踪、6 种预测模型与集成投票、组合结构分析、胆拖/随机选号，对话中直接调用 ssq 工具。

description.en: Stability audit for installed dsh plugins: static risk grading (hook surface, startup work, inject, entry, dep ranges) plus optional isolated install verification.
description.zh: 已安装 dsh 插件的稳定性审计：静态风险分级（钩子面/启动任务/inject/入口/依赖区间）加可选隔离安装验证。

description.en: Stage-gate governance tools: model-callable gate_open / gate_check / gate_list / gate_close for in-memory, per-session acceptance checks with PASS/BLOCK conclusions.
description.zh: 阶段门治理工具：模型可直接调用的 gate_open / gate_check / gate_list / gate_close，为多阶段工作提供内存态、按会话隔离的验收核对与通过/阻塞结论。

description.en: A curated plugin starter pack: batch-installs and configures 15 vetted community plugins across four groups from a Settings-page UI or the /setup command.
description.zh: 精选插件启动包：从设置页或 /setup 命令一键批量安装并配置 4 组共 15 个经过筛选的社区插件。

description.en: 随手抽屉 · Handy Drawer — DSH plugin: stash 'later' snippets during AI chats, then pick & ask in place. 低打扰、不打断心流。
description.zh: 随手把聊天里稍后再看的片段收进抽屉，需要时就地追问，不打断心流。

description.en: Native memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness — auditable facts with evidence chains, powered by StateCore
Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness. Per-channel usage with balances and plan quotas for mainstream providers, CNY cost estimates, and daily charts — a settings-sidebar section.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Token 用量统计。按渠道区分统计，官方渠道自动显示余额，套餐渠道显示 5 小时/7 天/30 天用量余量，人民币计费估算，含每日图表与模型分布，集成在设置页侧边菜单。

description.en: Adds a configurable dsh-ui status card before each DSH agent reply, with bilingual templates and a live settings preview. Requires @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui from dsh-market; without it, the card markup is emitted unrendered.
description.zh: 为每次 DSH Agent 回复添加可配置的 dsh-ui 状态卡片，提供双语模板和实时设置预览。需要先从 dsh-market 安装 @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui，否则卡片标记会以未渲染的形式输出。

description.en: dsh status plugin；可以方便的查看宿主机的运行状态，故障时方便排查
description.zh: dsh status plugin；可以方便的查看宿主机的运行状态，故障时方便排查

description.en: Nine consolidated tools that give agents full access to the stool ops CLI: server management, database query/redis, log search/tail, CI/CD deploy and history, MFA codes, git operations, notes, todos, and misc utilities (accounting, weekly reports, audit, project listing, nginx presets).
description.zh: 将 stool 运维 CLI 的全部能力整合为 9 个合并工具，Agent 可直接调用：服务器管理、数据库查询与 Redis、日志搜索与尾部查看、CI/CD 部署与历史、MFA 动态码、Git 仓库操作、笔记管理、待办任务，以及记账、周报、审计、项目列表、Nginx 预设等杂项工具。

description.zh: 子代理委派提供方：通过可配置的 executablePath 字段，运行任意 Claude 兼容 CLI 二进制。

description.en: DSH Web extension: live subagent monitor + role-based subagent routing + Claude Code style .dsh/agents/*.md persona injection
description.zh: 在浏览器里实时监控子代理运行，按角色智能分配任务，还能用Markdown文件定义代理人格，让多智能体协作更顺手。

description.zh: 把完整 Harness 环境变量透传给子进程（可拆卸的调试向插件）。

description.en: Trending-topics collector aggregating Baidu / Toutiao / Douyin / Weibo hot lists in one call (Weibo optional cookie), returning titles with heat values for content creators — tool: `sxs_news_hot`.
description.zh: 时事热点采集：一次调用聚合百度热搜 / 头条热榜 / 抖音热点 / 微博热搜（微博可选 cookie），返回标题+热度值，供内容创作借势——工具：`sxs_news_hot`。

description.en: Three Departments and Six Ministries governance mode plugin for DeepSeek Harness | dsh 三省六部模式插件

description.zh: Tavily search provider for DeepSeek Harness with full search-control mapping, credential-backed key UI, and guarded rc.6 patches.

description.en: Persistent interactive terminal mode for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: A black hole theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web UI.

description.zh: 16 套第三方主题皮肤：Catppuccin/Gruvbox/Everforest 等。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 主题选择插件：管理应用主题与已安装主题插件，同一时间仅一个主题生效。

One-click skin switching for DSH Web settings: auto-detects installed themes, keeps exactly one active at a time, and falls back to the official look when all are off. Changes apply instantly and survive restarts.
description.zh: DSH 主题切换：自动检测已安装的皮肤/主题，在设置页一键互斥切换，全部停用时回退官方默认外观，切换即时生效并跨重启保留。

description.en: Look & theme plugin for the DSH Web UI: built-in palettes, light/dark/follow-system appearance modes, Open VSX theme search & install, and VS Code theme import with a persisted theme library.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 外观与主题插件：内置调色板、明 / 暗 / 跟随系统外观模式、Open VSX 主题搜索导入与 VS Code 主题导入，主题库持久化。

description.en: dsh-think-autoexpand：让 DeepSeek Harness 里的 Think 思考行始终可见，并在流式输出时自动展开，实时查看 Agent 完整推理过程；保留工具卡折叠体验。
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 中的思考过程始终可见并自动展开，实时查看 Agent 完整推理，同时保留工具卡折叠体验。

description.en: Pins every request to native `max` reasoning effort instead of the `ultra` option, with isolated Flash / Pro / Vision depth presets. Distributed as a build-only artifact: the core is closed and its license forbids reverse-engineering, deobfuscation and repackaging.

description.en: Switch the language of the agent's thinking/reasoning process (chain-of-thought): 简体中文, English, Русский, Français, Deutsch, Español, 日本語, 한국어 and more, or auto-follow the system locale. Adds a Settings → General row, a system-prompt instruction (per-prompt assembly, applies to new sessions), and the /thinking-language command.

description.en: Detect & break thinking-chain loops in DSH agents at the turn boundary (no proxy). Ported from ollama-loop-guard.
description.zh: 在 turn 边界检测并打断智能体的思维链死循环，避免烧 token 卡住 agent。

description.en: Tiered auto-review for DeepSeek Harness: static-rule safety net + LLM reviewer + human fallback — auto-allow safe actions, deny irreversible ones, ask a human for the rest.

description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体加个定时闹钟，支持任务列表和 UI 展示，适合跑长期任务时自动唤醒提醒。

description.en: 给每次 AI 对话装一根 Token 保险丝：为每条用户消息设置独立总预算，统一约束输入、缓存、思考与回答。A per-conversation total-token safety fuse for DeepSeek Harness, with a whale slider and automatic reset on the next user message.
description.zh: 给每次 AI 对话装一根 Token 保险丝，按消息设定总预算，自动控制输入、思考与回答，防止超支。

description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里直观查看 Token 用量、供应商余额和订阅配额，帮你随时掌握消耗情况。

DSH 实时 Token 花费与账户余额显示插件（每轮花费 · 总花费 · 余额）

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI Token 用量展示插件：单会话胶囊 + 全局每日/按模型消耗面板（只读日志，零配置）| Token usage display plugin: per-session pill + global daily/per-model consumption panel

description.en: OpenAI-compatible image generation in DSH Desktop chat: generate inline, edit reference images or chain-edit previous results directly (image-to-image) without re-uploading, with storage cleanup.

description.en: Design note and interactive prototype for tool-owned render: each tool owns its own result presentation, composing shared layout primitives instead of a central render-kind union.

description.en: Modular search tool for DeepSeek Harness: attach SearXNG, RAG and your own sections to the native web_search.

description.en: Authentication gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: login covers pages, /api, /plugins and WebSocket upgrades; PBKDF2 password hashing, HttpOnly SameSite session cookies, IP-based login lockout, a user-management settings panel (users edit their own profile, admins add or remove users and reset passwords), admin-only model and API-key configuration guards, per-user isolation on the REST/list APIs and the WebSocket event streams, session persistence across restarts, a JSONL audit log, and a fail-closed gateway.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 认证网关：登录门禁覆盖页面、/api、/plugins 与 WebSocket 升级；PBKDF2 口令哈希、HttpOnly SameSite 会话 Cookie、按源 IP 登录锁定；设置面板内置用户管理（普通用户仅可修改本人资料与密码，管理员可新增/删除用户、重置密码、调整角色）；模型配置与 API Key 仅管理员可修改；REST/列表接口与 WebSocket 事件流均按用户隔离；会话重启后免登录恢复；JSONL 审计日志；存储故障时保持 fail-closed。

Browser mic streams 16 kHz PCM to the bridge, which runs Alibaba Cloud DashScope ASR (paraformer-realtime-v2); interim text fills the draft at the cursor, silence auto-stop, optional auto-send.
description.zh: 国内可用的输入框语音输入。需要先启动本地 Python bridge（pip install dashscope websockets，运行 bridge/voice-bridge.py）——只装插件不可用。浏览器麦克风采集 16kHz PCM 流式转发给 bridge，由阿里云 DashScope ASR（paraformer-realtime-v2）识别；识别文字在光标处实时填入草稿，静音自动停止，可选识别后自动发送。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 语音输入插件：麦克风按钮/快捷键录音，实时转写回填输入框。三种识别引擎：浏览器 Web Speech、本地 SenseVoice/Paraformer 离线后端（一键部署）、OpenAI 兼容云端 ASR API。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 语音输入插件：麦克风按钮/快捷键录音，实时转写回填输入框。三种识别引擎：浏览器 Web Speech、本地 SenseVoice/Paraformer 离线后端（一键部署）、OpenAI 兼容云端 ASR API。

description.en: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加上麦克风，直接说话就能提问，解放双手。

description.en: DSH 插件:vqa_ask 双模型视觉问答 —— 主模型提问 → 视觉模型看图回答,UI 实时展示 QA 过程,支持多模态视觉模型选择
description.zh: DSH 插件:vqa_ask 双模型视觉问答 —— 主模型提问 → 视觉模型看图回答,UI 实时展示 QA 过程,支持多模态视觉模型选择

description.en: Imports .vsix theme files made for Visual Studio Code and applies them to the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 导入为 Visual Studio Code 设计的 .vsix 主题文件并应用到 DSH Web UI。

description.en: Wallpaper skin for the DSH Web UI: presets, image URL or upload, and an opacity slider that fades the interface to reveal the wallpaper.
description.zh: DSH Web 壁纸皮肤：预设 / 图片 URL / 本地上传，透明度滑块让整面界面透出壁纸。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web UI Standalone Wallpaper Background Plugin: Three sources including built-in wallpapers, custom uploads, and Wallpaper Engine library (read-only). Supports image, video, and scene preview rendering, along with adjustments for overlay, blur, brightness, and safe zoom.

description.en: Wallpaper backgrounds for the DSH web GUI. Windows: reads your Wallpaper Engine (Steam) library and plays video/web wallpapers behind the chat. macOS: scans the WaifuX download folder and loose media folders automatically — anything saved in WaifuX becomes a DSH background with zero setup. Liquid-glass blur, dim and border sliders.
description.zh: DSH Web 聊天背景壁纸。Windows：直接读取你的 Wallpaper Engine（Steam）库，把视频/网页壁纸渲染到聊天界面背后。macOS：自动扫描 WaifuX 下载目录和媒体文件夹——在 WaifuX 里保存的壁纸零配置即可成为 DSH 背景，支持视频与图片。带毛玻璃模糊、压暗、边框调节滑块。

description.en: One-click DSH background switcher backed by local Wallpaper Engine images/videos
Subtitle-first video transcription with SRT export, cancellable job controls, and a faster-whisper large-v3 fallback when subtitles are unavailable.
description.zh: 字幕优先的视频转录，支持 SRT 导出与可取消任务控制；字幕不可用时回退到 faster-whisper `large-v3`。

description.en: Reusable skill to browse, search and download Wallpaper Engine (Steam 431960) workshop wallpapers and wire them into the DSH skin center, including bypassing the Steam HTTP block and the region-mismatch sign-in block via a matching SOCKS proxy.
description.zh: 可复用技能：批量浏览、搜索、下载 Wallpaper Engine（小红车，Steam 431960）创意工坊壁纸并接入 DSH 皮肤中心；含绕过 Steam HTTP 封锁与异地登录拦截（经出口 IP 与账号一致的 SOCKS 代理）。

description.en: DSH Web UI enhancement plugin: turn-by-turn conversation navigation & thinking-chain default-expand DSH Web UI 增强插件:逐轮对话导航、思维链默认展开
description.zh: DSH Web UI enhancement plugin: turn-by-turn conversation navigation & thinking-chain default-expand DSH Web UI 增强插件:逐轮对话导航、思维链默认展开

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex Web Search 能力。

description.zh: 支持自由配置多种第三方搜索引擎，自动抓取网页全文，让模型真正能搜能读。

description.en: deepseek harness 背景主题插件
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换个背景主题，让界面更顺眼，用起来更舒服。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) WebGIS Plugin: Map reading, map manipulation, and 3D world comprehension.
description.zh: 让 AI 真正看懂地图和三维世界，能加载、理解并操作 GIS 数据，在对话里直接完成地图分析。

description.en: 一个deepseek harness webfetch的代理插件，让llm也能科学上网

description.zh: 把微信私聊接入本地 DSH，让你用微信就能跟 agent 干活，体验比 openclaw 顺滑多了。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）微信远程控制插件：扫码绑定微信官方机器人（iLink/clawbot），在微信里远程操控 DSH agent——支持工作区多选与 /ws 切换
Codex-style Git workbench: workspace-scoped changes, diff, stage, commit, guarded branch operations, graph history, fetch, fast-forward pull, and upstream push through official plugin APIs.

description.zh: A native DSH desktop whale with growth, achievements, skins, and privacy-safe progress tracking

description.zh: 宝可梦式捕捉收集：真实工作就是草丛 —— 回合、工具调用、报错刷出野外遭遇；投球捕捉、集 28 格图鉴、带 6 只队伍。零 token，模型完全看不见。

description.zh: 插件作者的契约回归风洞：剧本适配器在隔离子进程中驱动真实管线，会话事件断言覆盖加载/契约/行为/故障四层；零 API key，可进 CI。

description.en: Windows Package Manager: search, install, upgrade, uninstall, import/export and pin software through native tools.
description.zh: Windows 包管理器：搜索、安装、升级、卸载、导入导出与版本固定。

description.zh: 通过 WinRM 管理 Windows 主机，提供 PowerShell 执行、服务与进程管理、SMB/分块文件传输（SHA-256 校验）、集群并发，以及 GUI 面板和七个 agent 工具。

通过 OAuth 2.0 安全绑定 X 账号，让 DeepSeek Harness 直接读取和发布 X 内容，实现社交媒体数据接入。
